已经把这次 **R015-V002** 的真实线上结果写入实验文档，并追加了下一步 **R028-V001** 的实验计划：

[更新后的实验记录文档](sandbox:/mnt/data/三份汇总去重评估_更新至R015-V002.md)

文档中已经记录：R015-V001 的 Runtime Error、R015-V002 的 15/15 Pass、相对 D baseline 几何平均约 **+1.81%**，以及“冻结 R015 当前 checkpoint、下一条独立路线转 R028”的结论。

## 下一步：R028-V001

我建议**不要从 R015-V002 继续改**，而是重新从 **D baseline** 建立独立 `R028` 分支。这样以后才能得到真正的单路线消融结果。

本轮只验证一个假设：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    D[D baseline] --> A[Row 0 RMS]
    A --> B[Row 1 RMS]
    B --> C[一次 V→S]
    C --> D2[读取 RMS0 + RMS1]
    D2 --> E[一次 S→V]
    E --> F[分别执行 Row0 / Row1 Pass2]
```

原来两行需要：

```text
Row0: V→S → GetValue → S→V
Row1: V→S → GetValue → S→V
```

R028-V001 改成：

```text
Row0 RMS 保存在 UB
Row1 RMS 保存在 UB

V→S
GetValue(RMS0)
GetValue(RMS1)
S→V
```

**DMA 次数、DMA 大小、ReduceSum、gamma/bias、输出、Tile、Div、Sqrt 全部不改。**

这不是拍脑袋的方向。你最开始提供的高性能参考代码明确有“小行 batch，使 RMS 的 V/S handoff 按 batch 支付而不是按 row 支付”的设计。fileciteturn7file2L173-L188 实际实现也是一次 `SyncVToS()` 后连续读取多个 row 的 reduction value，再一次 `SyncSToV()`。fileciteturn9file0L54-L72

下面是完整 **R028-V001**。

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias
 * R028-V001 - two-row RMS scalar synchronization batching
 *
 * Parent:
 *   D baseline (15/15 Pass)
 *
 * ONLY optimization hypothesis:
 *
 *   For two consecutive rows:
 *
 *       Row0 RMS compute
 *       Row1 RMS compute
 *       ONE V -> S
 *       read RMS0 + RMS1
 *       ONE S -> V
 *
 * Instead of:
 *
 *       Row0: V -> S -> read -> S -> V
 *       Row1: V -> S -> read -> S -> V
 *
 * Everything else remains on the D-baseline path:
 *
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - two-pass algorithm
 *   - FP32 intermediates
 *   - ReduceSum
 *   - residualFp32 reused as reduction workspace
 *   - per-row x/residual DMA
 *   - per-row gamma/bias DMA
 *   - per-row output store
 *   - Div + Sqrt
 *   - rowGroup/core assignment
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;

    /*
     * sumBuf layout:
     *
     * [0]   : shared partial ReduceSum result
     * [8]   : row 0 RMS
     * [16]  : row 1 RMS
     *
     * 24 floats = 96 bytes.
     */
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 24;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            yFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            sumBuf_,
            kScalarElems * sizeof(float));
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup,
        uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        const uint64_t baseGroups =
            groupCount /
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t extraGroups =
            groupCount %
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginGroup =
            blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? blockIdx
                 : extraGroups);

        const uint64_t localGroups =
            baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? 1
                 : 0);

        const uint64_t endGroup =
            beginGroup + localGroups;

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            beginGroup * rowGroup;

        uint64_t endRow =
            endGroup * rowGroup;

        if (endRow > rowCount) {
            endRow = rowCount;
        }

        uint64_t row = beginRow;

        /*
         * R028-V001:
         *
         * Process two rows as one scalar-sync batch.
         *
         * Their input/output DMA operations are still independent.
         */
        for (;
             row + 1 < endRow;
             row += 2) {

            ProcessTwoRowsSyncBatch(
                row,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
        }

        /*
         * Odd tail row:
         * completely unchanged D-baseline path.
         */
        for (;
             row < endRow;
             ++row) {

            ProcessRow(
                row,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
        }
    }

private:
    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        kTileElems)
                ? kTileElems
                : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T>
            padParams;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            copyParams,
            padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    /*
     * First pass only.
     *
     * Computes:
     *
     *   sqrt(mean((x + residual)^2) + epsilon)
     *
     * into rmsSlot.
     *
     * IMPORTANT:
     *
     * This function intentionally does NOT perform:
     *
     *   SyncVToS()
     *   GetValue()
     *   SyncSToV()
     *
     * That is deferred until both rows are complete.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ComputeRmsToSlot(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& rmsSlot)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rmsSlot,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            /*
             * residualFp32 is dead after Add,
             * same liveness reuse as D baseline.
             */
            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rmsSlot,
                rmsSlot,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rmsSlot,
            rmsSlot,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rmsSlot,
            rmsSlot,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rmsSlot,
            rmsSlot,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }

    /*
     * D-baseline second pass for one row.
     *
     * No DMA batching.
     * No gamma/bias caching.
     * No output batching.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessOutputRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float rmsValue)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                residualFp32,
                rmsValue,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<
                    T,
                    float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * R028-V001
     * =============================================================
     *
     * Two rows retain separate computation and DMA paths.
     *
     * Only scalar pipeline synchronization is shared.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessTwoRowsSyncBatch(
        uint64_t firstRow,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms0 =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms1 =
            sumSlots[16];

        /*
         * Row 0 and row 1 retain completely independent
         * first-pass input DMA and reductions.
         */
        ComputeRmsToSlot(
            firstRow,
            rowWidth,
            invRowWidth,
            epsilon,
            rms0);

        ComputeRmsToSlot(
            firstRow + 1,
            rowWidth,
            invRowWidth,
            epsilon,
            rms1);

        /*
         * THE ONLY R028 OPTIMIZATION:
         *
         * One V -> S handoff for two RMS values.
         */
        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue0 =
            rms0.GetValue(0);

        const float rmsValue1 =
            rms1.GetValue(0);

        /*
         * One S -> V handoff for both values.
         */
        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * Pass 2 stays per row.
         */
        ProcessOutputRow(
            firstRow,
            rowWidth,
            rmsValue0);

        ProcessOutputRow(
            firstRow + 1,
            rowWidth,
            rmsValue1);
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * UNCHANGED D-BASELINE SINGLE-ROW PATH
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * PASS 1
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * PASS 2
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                residualFp32,
                rmsValue,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<
                    T,
                    float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        yFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        sumBuf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};


template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}


#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||

        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||

        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {

        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||

        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||

        residualInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        outputInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            residualInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            gammaInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            biasInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            outputInfo.dtype) {

        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {

        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned) {

            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                extentSigned);

        if (rowCount >
            maxU64 / extent) {

            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        rowCount == 0) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth >
            maxU64 / elementBytes ||
        rowCount >
            maxU64 / rowWidth) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth * elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA = rowBytes;
    uint64_t gcdB = 32;

    while (gcdB != 0) {

        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA % gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32 / gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount / rowGroup +
        (rowCount % rowGroup == 0
             ? 0
             : 1);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks >
        groupCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            groupCount;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks >
        maxBlockCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0) {
        requestedBlocks = 1;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

这一版的实验解释会非常干净：

```text
R028-V001
Parent = D baseline

唯一性能变化：
2 rows / scalar sync batch

sumBuf：
64 B → 96 B

DMA：
不变

ReduceSum：
不变

数学：
不变

gamma/bias：
不变

输出：
不变
```

如果它 15/15 Pass，再直接和 **D baseline** 比，而不是和 R015-V002 比。这样我们会得到：

```text
D
├── R015-V002  → DMA 路线线上效果
└── R028-V001  → Sync 路线线上效果
```

等 R028 的线上结果出来后，再决定是否值得建立第三条独立的 `R015 + R028` 混合分支。

R015 和 R028 是**完全不同的优化**，但它们在很多测试点上的结果几乎一样：

# 下一条我建议：R002 单遍 y 驻留

现在我会把优先级改成：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[R015<br/>已测] --> B[R028<br/>已测]
    B --> C[R002<br/>下一步]
    C --> D[R014]
    D --> E[R013]
    E --> F[R011]
```

## 为什么选 R002

当前 D 每一行做了两次：

```text
x load
residual load
cast FP32
x + residual
```

结构是：

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Pass 1] --> B[Load x/residual]
    B --> C[得到 y]
    C --> D[平方 + ReduceSum]
    D --> E[RMS]

    E --> F[Pass 2]
    F --> G[再次 Load x/residual]
    G --> H[再次 Cast]
    H --> I[再次计算 y]
    I --> J[Normalize + Gamma/Bias]
```

但对于一整行可以驻留在 UB 的情况，第一遍的：

```text
y = x + residual
```

其实已经存在 `yFp32Buf_` 中。

所以可以：

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Load x/residual] --> B[计算 y]
    B --> C[保留 yFp32]
    C --> D[使用其他 buffer 做平方和]
    D --> E[RMS]
    E --> F[直接使用保存的 y]
    F --> G[Normalize]
    G --> H[Gamma/Bias]
```

直接删除第二遍的：

```text
Load x
Load residual
ToFloat x
ToFloat residual
Add
```

这个改动的理论强度明显比刚才：

```text
2次 V/S sync → 1次
```

要大。

---

# R002-V001 应该严格只做这一件事

建议第一版保守：

```cpp
rowWidth <= 4096
```

才启用。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[输入] --> B{rowWidth <= 4096?}

    B -->|否| D[D baseline<br/>两遍扫描]

    B -->|是| S[R002路径]
    S --> S1[Pass1 load x/residual]
    S1 --> S2[y保留在 yFp32]
    S2 --> S3[计算 RMS]
    S3 --> S4[不再读取 x/residual]
    S4 --> S5[y / rms]
    S5 --> S6[gamma + bias]
```

### R002-V001 不允许顺带修改

```text
× gamma/bias cache
× multi-row DMA
× scalar sync batching
× double buffer
× ReduceSum
× tile size
× row scheduling
× reciprocal
```

这样线上结果才能明确回答：

> **“第二次 x/residual GM 读取 + cast + add”到底占多少成本？**

---

## 当前路线状态

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    D[D baseline<br/>15/15] --> R15[R015-V002<br/>15/15<br/>+1.81%]
    D --> R28[R028-V001<br/>15/15<br/>+0.22%]
    D --> R2[R002-V001<br/>下一实验]

    R15 --> M[保留]
    R28 --> X[当前变体停止]
    R2 --> Q{线上结果}

    Q -->|明显提升| Y[继续深入 R002]
    Q -->|无提升| Z[转 R014]
```

**所以下一个我建议直接做 `R002-V001`，而不是继续在 R028 上调 batch。**

而且这一次我们的目标不再满足于 3%～5%；如果 R002 仍然只是几个百分点，就可以比较明确地说明真正的大性能差距来自更高层次的 **多行融合 / 参数驻留 / pipeline / shape-specific dispatch**，而不是这些小型局部修改。

## [0380] assistant · 2026-09-16 21:49:28
下面直接给 **R002-V001**。这一版从 **D baseline** 独立分支开始，不继承 R015/R028。

唯一优化：

> 当 `rowWidth <= 4096` 时，第一遍计算出的 `y = x + residual` 保留在 `yFp32Buf_`，算出 RMS 后直接继续归一化，删除第二遍对 `x/residual` 的重新读取、转换和相加。

其他全部保持 D 版逻辑不变。

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias
 *
 * R002-V001
 * Route: single-pass retained-y path
 *
 * Parent:
 *   D baseline
 *
 * ONLY optimization:
 *
 *   When rowWidth <= 4096:
 *
 *     Pass 1:
 *       load x/residual
 *       cast to FP32
 *       y = x + residual
 *       keep y in yFp32Buf_
 *       compute RMS using xFp32/residualFp32 as work buffers
 *
 *     After RMS:
 *       reuse retained y directly
 *       DO NOT reload x/residual
 *       DO NOT recast x/residual
 *       DO NOT recompute x + residual
 *
 * Everything else is unchanged:
 *
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - ReduceSum
 *   - FP32 intermediate arithmetic
 *   - residualFp32 used as reduction/normalization workspace
 *   - scalar RMS synchronization
 *   - per-row gamma/bias loads
 *   - per-row output stores
 *   - Div + Sqrt
 *   - rowGroup/core assignment
 *
 * For rowWidth > 4096:
 *   use the unchanged D-baseline two-pass path.
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;

    /*
     * Conservative first experiment.
     *
     * The retained-y path is enabled only for complete rows
     * no wider than 4096 elements.
     */
    static constexpr uint64_t kCachedRowMaxWidth = 4096ULL;

    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            yFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            sumBuf_,
            kScalarElems * sizeof(float));
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup,
        uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        const uint64_t baseGroups =
            groupCount /
            static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);

        const uint64_t extraGroups =
            groupCount %
            static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginGroup =
            blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? blockIdx
                 : extraGroups);

        const uint64_t localGroups =
            baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? 1
                 : 0);

        const uint64_t endGroup =
            beginGroup + localGroups;

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            beginGroup * rowGroup;

        uint64_t endRow =
            endGroup * rowGroup;

        if (endRow > rowCount) {
            endRow = rowCount;
        }

        /*
         * R002-V001 dispatch.
         *
         * Only this shape domain uses the new retained-y path.
         */
        const bool useCachedY =
            rowWidth <= kCachedRowMaxWidth;

        for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
             row < endRow;
             ++row) {

            if (useCachedY) {
                ProcessCachedYRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            } else {
                ProcessRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
        }
    }

private:
    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        kTileElems)
                ? kTileElems
                : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T>
            padParams;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            copyParams,
            padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * R002-V001
     *
     * RETAIN y IN UB
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessCachedYRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * Load x/residual exactly once.
         * =========================================================
         */
        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * y is retained in yFp32 for the remainder of this row.
         */
        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * xFp32 is now free.
         *
         * Use it for y^2 while preserving yFp32 unchanged.
         */
        AscendC::Mul(
            xFp32,
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * residualFp32 is also dead after y was formed,
         * so keep the D-baseline liveness reuse and use it
         * as ReduceSum workspace.
         */
        AscendC::ReduceSum(
            partial,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * There is only one tile in this R002 path,
         * so partial already contains the full-row sum.
         *
         * Copy it into the established RMS scalar slot.
         */
        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            partial,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * THIS IS THE R002 OPTIMIZATION.
         *
         * D baseline would now:
         *
         *   Load x again
         *   Load residual again
         *   ToFloat(x)
         *   ToFloat(residual)
         *   Add(y)
         *
         * R002 keeps the original y in yFp32Buf_, so all of those
         * operations are removed.
         * =========================================================
         */

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            residualFp32,
            rmsValue,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Div(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * Before starting new MTE2 gamma/bias loads,
         * preserve the same V -> MTE2 ordering discipline.
         */
        SyncVToMTE2();

        /*
         * Gamma/bias behavior intentionally remains unchanged.
         */
        Load(
            xLocal,
            gammaGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            biasGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                xLocal,
                yFp32,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();
        }

        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * UNCHANGED D BASELINE
     *
     * Used when rowWidth > 4096.
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * PASS 1
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * PASS 2
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                residualFp32,
                rmsValue,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<
                    T,
                    float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        yFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        sumBuf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};


template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}


#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||

        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||

        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {

        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||

        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||

        residualInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        outputInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            residualInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            gammaInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            biasInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            outputInfo.dtype) {

        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {

        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned) {

            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                extentSigned);

        if (rowCount >
            maxU64 / extent) {

            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        rowCount == 0) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth >
            maxU64 / elementBytes ||
        rowCount >
            maxU64 / rowWidth) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth * elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA = rowBytes;
    uint64_t gcdB = 32;

    while (gcdB != 0) {

        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA % gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32 / gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount / rowGroup +
        (rowCount % rowGroup == 0
             ? 0
             : 1);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks >
        groupCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            groupCount;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks >
        maxBlockCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0) {
        requestedBlocks = 1;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

### 这次实验记录先定义为

```text
R002-V001

Parent:
D baseline

唯一假设:
对于 rowWidth <= 4096 的完整行，
保留第一遍得到的 FP32 y，
消除第二遍 x/residual GM 读取 + Cast + Add。

Activation:
rowWidth <= 4096

保持不变:
Tile = 8192
ReduceSum
RMS
同步
gamma/bias
输出
分核
dtype
Div/Sqrt

当前状态:
待线上验证
```

这版尤其值得看 **Case 4 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 10 / 14** 是否出现超过之前 `3%~5%` 噪声区间的变化。若仍只有几个百分点，下一步就不再继续微调 R002 阈值，而转 **R014 gamma/bias 驻留**。

驻留实验记录（已执行）\n\n#### R002-V001\n\n- Parent：D baseline；不叠加 R015/R028。\n- 唯一主要假设：当 `rowWidth <= 4096` 时，将第一遍得到的 FP32 `y = x + residual` 保存在 `yFp32Buf_` 中；RMS 计算结束后直接使用该 y 完成归一化，删除第二遍对 `x/residual` 的 GM 并不合适。由于当前缺少隐藏 Case 的 shape 元数据，不应根据 Case 编号猜测更细阈值。\n- 路线结论：保留 `R002-V001` 为 R002 当前 checkpoint，不立即根据隐藏 Case 猜测激活域；下一条独立路线转 `R014-GammaBias驻留`，继续建立单路线线上消融证据。\n- 后续组合原则：只有获得 R014/R013 等独立线上结果后，再考虑将 R002 的 shape-specific 快路径与其他路线组合。\n'''
