---

# 下一版本：R014-V001

这次从 **D baseline** 独立开分支，不继承 R002。

唯一修改：

```text
gamma / bias
原来：每处理一行，从 GM 重新加载一次

R014-V001：
当 D <= 4096 且一个 Core 至少处理两行时，
gamma / bias 只加载一次，
驻留在 xBuf / residualBuf 后半区，
后续所有行复用。
```

UB 不新增大 Buffer：

```text
xBuf[0 ... 4095]       当前 x
xBuf[4096 ... 8191]    gamma cache

residualBuf[0 ... 4095]       当前 residual
residualBuf[4096 ... 8191]    bias cache
```

这样能够非常干净地测试：

> **重复加载 gamma/bias 是否是大 outer 场景的重要瓶颈。**

## 完整代码

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias
 *
 * R014-V001
 * Route: Gamma/Bias residency
 *
 * Parent:
 *   D baseline
 *
 * ONLY optimization:
 *
 *   If:
 *
 *       rowWidth <= 4096
 *       && this AI Core owns at least two rows
 *
 *   gamma and bias are loaded from GM ONCE per AI Core
 *   and retained in the unused second half of xBuf_/residualBuf_.
 *
 * Buffer layout:
 *
 *   xBuf_
 *     [0, 4096)       current x row
 *     [4096, 8192)    cached gamma
 *
 *   residualBuf_
 *     [0, 4096)       current residual row
 *     [4096, 8192)    cached bias
 *
 * No extra large UB buffer is introduced.
 *
 * Everything else remains D baseline:
 *
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - two-pass x/residual algorithm
 *   - FP32 intermediate arithmetic
 *   - ReduceSum
 *   - RMS scalar synchronization
 *   - Div + Sqrt
 *   - per-row output store
 *   - rowGroup/core assignment
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 *   gamma/bias remain in their original dtype in UB.
 *   Their FP32 conversion remains per row.
 *
 * Therefore this experiment isolates GM parameter residency,
 * rather than mixing residency with parameter-cast caching.
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;

    static constexpr int32_t kParamCacheOffset = 4096;
    static constexpr uint64_t kParamCacheMaxWidth = 4096ULL;

    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)x);

        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)residual);

        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)gamma);

        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)bias);

        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            yFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            sumBuf_,
            kScalarElems * sizeof(float));
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup,
        uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        const uint64_t baseGroups =
            groupCount /
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t extraGroups =
            groupCount %
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginGroup =
            blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? blockIdx
                 : extraGroups);

        const uint64_t localGroups =
            baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? 1ULL
                 : 0ULL);

        const uint64_t endGroup =
            beginGroup + localGroups;

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            beginGroup * rowGroup;

        uint64_t endRow =
            endGroup * rowGroup;

        if (endRow > rowCount) {
            endRow = rowCount;
        }

        const uint64_t localRows =
            endRow > beginRow
                ? endRow - beginRow
                : 0ULL;

        /*
         * R014-V001 activation.
         *
         * Parameter residency has value only if one core reuses
         * gamma/bias across multiple rows.
         */
        const bool useParamCache =
            rowWidth <= kParamCacheMaxWidth &&
            localRows > 1ULL;

        if (useParamCache) {

            PrepareParameterCache(
                rowWidth);

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessCachedParameterRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }

        } else {

            /*
             * Completely unchanged D-baseline path.
             */
            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
        }
    }

private:

    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        kTileElems)
                ? kTileElems
                : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T>
            padParams;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            copyParams,
            padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * R014-V001
     *
     * Cache gamma/bias once per AI Core.
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void PrepareParameterCache(
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        /*
         * Fixed 4096-element boundary prevents overlap between
         * current row data and cached channel parameters.
         */
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        Load(
            gammaCached,
            gammaGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        Load(
            biasCached,
            biasGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        /*
         * Complete the one-time GM -> UB parameter transfer
         * before any row consumes the cache.
         */
        SyncMTE2ToV();
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * R014 cached-parameter row path.
     *
     * Only difference versus D baseline:
     *
     *   gamma/bias are read from cached UB slices instead of GM.
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessCachedParameterRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        /*
         * The cache path is activated only for rowWidth <= 4096,
         * therefore the complete row always fits in the first
         * half of the 8192-element buffers.
         */
        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * PASS 1
         *
         * Identical to D baseline.
         * =========================================================
         */

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        /*
         * These loads write only [0, rowWidth).
         * Cached gamma/bias start at element 4096.
         */
        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            xFp32,
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::ReduceSum(
            partial,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            rms,
            rms,
            partial,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToMTE2();

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * PASS 2
         *
         * x/residual behavior remains unchanged.
         * =========================================================
         */

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            residualFp32,
            rmsValue,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Div(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * R014 OPTIMIZATION
         *
         * D baseline:
         *
         *   SyncVToMTE2()
         *   Load gamma from GM
         *   Load bias from GM
         *   SyncMTE2ToV()
         *
         * R014:
         *
         *   gamma/bias already reside in UB.
         *
         * Their per-row conversion remains unchanged to keep this
         * experiment isolated to parameter GM residency.
         * =========================================================
         */

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            gammaCached,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            biasCached,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();

        } else {

            /*
             * Cast writes only the first rowWidth elements,
             * so the gamma cache in the second half of xBuf_
             * remains intact.
             */
            AscendC::Cast(
                xLocal,
                yFp32,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();
        }

        /*
         * Preserve D-baseline V -> MTE2 ordering before
         * the next row begins loading x/residual.
         */
        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * D BASELINE
     *
     * Used when:
     *
     *   rowWidth > 4096
     *   or
     *   this core owns only one row
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * PASS 1
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * PASS 2
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                residualFp32,
                rmsValue,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<
                    T,
                    float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:

    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        yFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        sumBuf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};


template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}


#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||

        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||

        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {

        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||

        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||

        residualInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        outputInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            residualInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            gammaInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            biasInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            outputInfo.dtype) {

        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {

        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned) {

            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                extentSigned);

        if (rowCount >
            maxU64 / extent) {

            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        rowCount == 0) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth >
            maxU64 / elementBytes ||
        rowCount >
            maxU64 / rowWidth) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth * elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA =
        rowBytes;

    uint64_t gcdB =
        32ULL;

    while (gcdB != 0ULL) {

        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA % gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32ULL / gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount / rowGroup +
        (rowCount % rowGroup == 0ULL
             ? 0ULL
             : 1ULL);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks >
        groupCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            groupCount;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks >
        maxBlockCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0ULL) {
        requestedBlocks = 1ULL;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

```text
Parent: D baseline

唯一修改:

从 每行一次

rowWidth <= 4096
localRows > 1

UB:
不增加大Buffer
使用现有xBuf/residualBuf后半区

不改变:
x/residual两遍读取
ReduceSum
RMS sync
Div/Sqrt
gamma/bias FP32转换
output
Tile
分核
```

这次 **R014-V001 是目前最重要的一次结果**。它不是几个百分点的波动，而是已经证明了一个明确的主瓶颈：

> **重复加载 gamma / bias 是当前实现的核心性能问题之一。**

# 下一版建议：R014-V002

我不建议现在切换路线。

R014 还明显没有搜完。

V001 只是：

```text
gamma/bias：
GM → UB，一次/Core
```

但是低精度情况下，每一行仍然重复：

```text
gamma half/bf16 → FP32
bias half/bf16  → FP32
```

FP32 情况也仍然每行做：

```cpp
Adds(xFp32, gammaCached, 0.0f, ...)
Adds(residualFp32, biasCached, 0.0f, ...)
```

也就是参数虽然不再访问 GM，但仍然存在**每行参数转换/复制**。

R014-V002 的唯一修改就是：

> **gamma/bias 不仅驻留 UB，而且直接驻留为可复用的 FP32 参数。**

---

## R014-V002 完整代码

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias
 *
 * R014-V002
 *
 * Parent:
 *   R014-V001
 *
 * V001:
 *   gamma/bias loaded from GM once per AI Core and retained in UB.
 *
 * V002 ONLY CHANGE:
 *
 *   Prepare reusable FP32 gamma/bias once per AI Core.
 *
 * FP32:
 *   cached gamma/bias are already float;
 *   use them directly in Mul/Add.
 *
 * FP16/BF16:
 *   convert cached gamma/bias to FP32 ONCE before row loop,
 *   then reuse FP32 parameters for every row.
 *
 * Everything else remains R014-V001:
 *
 *   - activation: rowWidth <= 4096 && localRows > 1
 *   - Tile = 8192
 *   - two-pass x/residual
 *   - ReduceSum
 *   - RMS scalar synchronization
 *   - Div + Sqrt
 *   - per-row output store
 *   - same row/core scheduling
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;

    static constexpr int32_t kParamCacheOffset = 4096;
    static constexpr int32_t kParamCacheElems = 4096;

    static constexpr uint64_t kParamCacheMaxWidth = 4096ULL;

    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)x);

        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)residual);

        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)gamma);

        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)bias);

        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer(
            (__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            yFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            sumBuf_,
            kScalarElems * sizeof(float));

        /*
         * R014-V002:
         *
         * FP16/BF16 need dedicated FP32 parameter caches.
         *
         * FP32 does not allocate these buffers because the raw
         * UB cache is already float.
         */
        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                gammaFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheElems *
                    sizeof(float));

            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                biasFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheElems *
                    sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup,
        uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        const uint64_t baseGroups =
            groupCount /
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t extraGroups =
            groupCount %
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginGroup =
            blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? blockIdx
                 : extraGroups);

        const uint64_t localGroups =
            baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? 1ULL
                 : 0ULL);

        const uint64_t endGroup =
            beginGroup + localGroups;

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            beginGroup * rowGroup;

        uint64_t endRow =
            endGroup * rowGroup;

        if (endRow > rowCount) {
            endRow = rowCount;
        }

        const uint64_t localRows =
            endRow > beginRow
                ? endRow - beginRow
                : 0ULL;

        /*
         * Keep exactly the same activation domain as V001.
         */
        const bool useParamCache =
            rowWidth <= kParamCacheMaxWidth &&
            localRows > 1ULL;

        if (useParamCache) {

            PrepareParameterCache(
                rowWidth);

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessCachedParameterRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }

        } else {

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
        }
    }

private:

    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        kTileElems)
                ? kTileElems
                : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T>
            padParams;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            copyParams,
            padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * R014-V002
     *
     * Prepare parameter cache once per AI Core.
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void PrepareParameterCache(
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        /*
         * Raw parameter cache inherited from V001.
         */
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        Load(
            gammaCached,
            gammaGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        Load(
            biasCached,
            biasGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        /*
         * New in V002:
         *
         * For low precision types, convert once and keep FP32
         * parameters for every row.
         */
        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                gammaFp32 =
                    gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                biasFp32 =
                    biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            ToFloat(
                gammaFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                biasFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            /*
             * Conservative one-time ordering before subsequent
             * MTE2 row loads begin.
             */
            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * R014 cached-parameter row.
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessCachedParameterRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * PASS 1
         * unchanged
         * =========================================================
         */

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            xFp32,
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::ReduceSum(
            partial,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            rms,
            rms,
            partial,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToMTE2();

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * PASS 2
         * unchanged x/residual path
         * =========================================================
         */

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            residualFp32,
            rmsValue,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Div(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * =========================================================
         * R014-V002 change:
         *
         * no per-row parameter ToFloat / Adds copies.
         * =========================================================
         */

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            /*
             * Cached parameters already are FP32.
             */
            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        } else {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                gammaFp32 =
                    gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                biasFp32 =
                    biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                xLocal,
                yFp32,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();
        }

        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    /*
     * =============================================================
     * D BASELINE
     * =============================================================
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float rmsValue =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                residualFp32,
                rmsValue,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<
                    T,
                    float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:

    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        yFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        sumBuf_;

    /*
     * Only initialized for FP16/BF16.
     */
    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        gammaFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        biasFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};


template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}


#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||

        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||

        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {

        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||

        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||

        residualInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        outputInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            residualInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            gammaInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            biasInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            outputInfo.dtype) {

        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {

        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned) {

            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                extentSigned);

        if (rowCount >
            maxU64 / extent) {

            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        rowCount == 0) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth >
            maxU64 / elementBytes ||
        rowCount >
            maxU64 / rowWidth) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth * elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA =
        rowBytes;

    uint64_t gcdB =
        32ULL;

    while (gcdB != 0ULL) {

        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA % gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32ULL / gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount / rowGroup +
        (rowCount % rowGroup == 0ULL
             ? 0ULL
             : 1ULL);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks >
        groupCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            groupCount;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks >
        maxBlockCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0ULL) {
        requestedBlocks = 1ULL;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

## 这一轮只看一个问题

```text
R014-V001
参数 GM 驻留

→ R014-V002
参数 FP32 也驻留
```

不要同时叠加 R002。

如果 V002 再能明显提升，那么继续深化 R014；如果只有 0～3% 左右变化，则可以把 **R014-V001/V002 中更快的那个冻结为 R014 Local Best**，下一步再去做 R013 或建立 `R014 + R002` 的独立混合分支。

```unknown
bash -lc cat > /mnt/data/addrmsnormbias_route_exploration_bundle/code/D-baseline_reconstructed.asc <<'EOF'
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias - stable D baseline reconstruction
 *
 * Status:
 *   Architecture corresponding to the 15/15-pass D baseline used as parent
 *   for later isolated route experiments. This packaged copy is reconstructed
 *   from the common fallback path embedded in the tested variants.
 *
 * Core properties:
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - two-pass per-row algorithm
 *   - FP32 intermediates
 *   - ReduceSum
 *   - residualFp32Buf_ reused as ReduceSum workspace / scalar denominator tile
 *   - per-row gamma/bias load
 *   - per-row output store
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x, GM_ADDR residual, GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias, GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(xBuf_, kTileElems * sizeof(T));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(residualBuf_, kTileElems * sizeof(T));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(xFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(residualFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(yFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(sumBuf_, kScalarElems * sizeof(float));
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount, uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup, uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount, float invRowWidth, float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx = static_cast<uint64_t>(AscendC::GetBlockIdx());
        const uint64_t baseGroups = groupCount / static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);
        const uint64_t extraGroups = groupCount % static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);
        const uint64_t beginGroup = blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups ? blockIdx : extraGroups);
        const uint64_t localGroups = baseGroups + (blockIdx < extraGroups ? 1ULL : 0ULL);
        const uint64_t endGroup = beginGroup + localGroups;
        const uint64_t beginRow = beginGroup * rowGroup;
        uint64_t endRow = endGroup * rowGroup;
        if (endRow > rowCount) endRow = rowCount;

        for (uint64_t row = beginRow; row < endRow; ++row) {
            ProcessRow(row, rowWidth, invRowWidth, epsilon);
        }
    }

private:
    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain > static_cast<uint64_t>(kTileElems) ? kTileElems : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset, int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1, static_cast<uint32_t>(count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))), 0, 0, 0);
        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padParams;
        AscendC::DataCopyPad(dst, src[offset], copyParams, padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1, static_cast<uint32_t>(count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))), 0, 0, 0);
        AscendC::DataCopyPad(dst[offset], src, copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Adds(dst, src, 0.0f, count);
        } else {
            AscendC::Cast(dst, src, AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE, count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV() {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }
    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2() {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }
    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3() {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }
    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV() {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }
    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS() {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }
    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV() {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row, uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth, float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset = row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal = xBuf_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal = residualBuf_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 = xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 = residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 = yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots = sumBuf_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial = sumSlots;
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms = sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(rms, 0.0f, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0; col < rowWidth; col += kTileElems) {
            const int32_t valid = TileLength(rowWidth - col);
            Load(xLocal, xGm_, rowOffset + col, valid);
            Load(residualLocal, residualGm_, rowOffset + col, valid);
            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(xFp32, xLocal, valid);
            ToFloat(residualFp32, residualLocal, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Add(yFp32, xFp32, residualFp32, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Mul(xFp32, yFp32, yFp32, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::ReduceSum(partial, xFp32, residualFp32, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Add(rms, rms, partial, 1);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(rms, rms, invRowWidth, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        AscendC::Adds(rms, rms, epsilon, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        AscendC::Sqrt(rms, rms, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        SyncVToS();
        const float rmsValue = rms.GetValue(0);
        SyncSToV();

        for (uint64_t col = 0; col < rowWidth; col += kTileElems) {
            const int32_t valid = TileLength(rowWidth - col);
            Load(xLocal, xGm_, rowOffset + col, valid);
            Load(residualLocal, residualGm_, rowOffset + col, valid);
            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(xFp32, xLocal, valid);
            ToFloat(residualFp32, residualLocal, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Add(yFp32, xFp32, residualFp32, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Duplicate(residualFp32, rmsValue, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Div(yFp32, yFp32, residualFp32, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(xLocal, gammaGm_, col, valid);
            Load(residualLocal, biasGm_, col, valid);
            SyncMTE2ToV();
            ToFloat(xFp32, xLocal, valid);
            ToFloat(residualFp32, residualLocal, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Mul(yFp32, yFp32, xFp32, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            AscendC::Add(yFp32, yFp32, residualFp32, valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                SyncVToMTE3();
                Store(outputGm_, rowOffset + col, yFp32, valid);
                SyncMTE3ToV();
            } else {
                AscendC::Cast(xLocal, yFp32, AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT, valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                SyncVToMTE3();
                Store(outputGm_, rowOffset + col, xLocal, valid);
                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }
            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> xBuf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> residualBuf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> xFp32Buf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> residualFp32Buf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> yFp32Buf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> sumBuf_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};

template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x, GM_ADDR residual, GM_ADDR gamma, GM_ADDR bias, GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount, uint64_t rowWidth, uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount, uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth, float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;
    op.Init(x, residual, gamma, bias, output);
    op.Process(rowCount, rowWidth, rowGroup, groupCount, blockCount, invRowWidth, epsilon);
}

#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)
extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x, const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,
    GM_ADDR residual, const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma, const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias, const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,
    GM_ADDR output, const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,
    int64_t availableCoreNum, aclrtStream stream, float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr || residual == nullptr || gamma == nullptr || bias == nullptr || output == nullptr ||
        info_x.tensors == nullptr || info_residual.tensors == nullptr || info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr || info_output.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_x.numTensors < 1 || info_residual.numTensors < 1 || info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 || info_output.numTensors < 1) return;

    const TensorInfo& xInfo = info_x.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& residualInfo = info_residual.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo = info_gamma.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& biasInfo = info_bias.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& outputInfo = info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr || residualInfo.shape == nullptr || gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr || outputInfo.shape == nullptr || xInfo.numDims < 1 ||
        residualInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims || outputInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 || biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        xInfo.dtype != residualInfo.dtype || xInfo.dtype != gammaInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != biasInfo.dtype || xInfo.dtype != outputInfo.dtype) return;

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 && xInfo.dtype != 1 && xInfo.dtype != 2) return;

    const int64_t widthSigned = xInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1];
    if (widthSigned <= 0 || gammaInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned || biasInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned) return;

    const uint64_t maxU64 = ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);
    uint64_t rowCount = 1;
    for (int64_t dim = 0; dim < xInfo.numDims - 1; ++dim) {
        const int64_t extentSigned = xInfo.shape[dim];
        if (extentSigned <= 0) return;
        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned || outputInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned) return;
        const uint64_t extent = static_cast<uint64_t>(extentSigned);
        if (rowCount > maxU64 / extent) return;
        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned ||
        outputInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned || rowCount == 0) return;

    const uint64_t rowWidth = static_cast<uint64_t>(widthSigned);
    const uint64_t elementBytes = xInfo.dtype == 0 ? 4ULL : 2ULL;
    if (rowWidth > maxU64 / elementBytes || rowCount > maxU64 / rowWidth) return;

    const uint64_t rowBytes = rowWidth * elementBytes;
    uint64_t gcdA = rowBytes;
    uint64_t gcdB = 32ULL;
    while (gcdB != 0ULL) {
        const uint64_t remainder = gcdA % gcdB;
        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup = 32ULL / gcdA;
    const uint64_t groupCount = rowCount / rowGroup + (rowCount % rowGroup == 0ULL ? 0ULL : 1ULL);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks = availableCoreNum > 0 ? static_cast<uint64_t>(availableCoreNum) : 1ULL;
    if (requestedBlocks > groupCount) requestedBlocks = groupCount;
    const uint64_t maxBlockCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(0xffffffffU);
    if (requestedBlocks > maxBlockCount) requestedBlocks = maxBlockCount;
    if (requestedBlocks == 0ULL) requestedBlocks = 1ULL;

    const uint32_t blockCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(requestedBlocks);
    const float invRowWidth = 1.0f / static_cast<float>(widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {
        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float><<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x, residual, gamma, bias, output, rowCount, rowWidth,
            rowGroup, groupCount, blockCount, invRowWidth, epsilon);
    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

            x, residual, gamma, bias, output, rowCount, rowWidth,
            rowGroup, groupCount, blockCount, invRowWidth, epsilon);
    }
}
```
