# A. `R020-V001-RSQRT`

唯一改动：

```text
Sqrt
→ Scalar 1/rms
→ Muls
```

变为：

```text
Rsqrt
→ 直接读取 invRms
→ Muls
```

Tile、DMA、ReduceSum、缓存、分核全部不变。

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias - R020-V001-RSQRT
 *
 * Parent: MIX-R014-R002-R019-V001
 * Status: candidate / not yet CANN-compiled or online tested here
 *
 * Single new mechanism:
 *   - replace Sqrt(x) + scalar reciprocal 1/x with vector Rsqrt(x)
 *     on the one-element RMS scalar tensor.
 *
 * Existing mechanisms retained unchanged:
 *   - R014-V002 parameter residency
 *   - R002 retained-y fast path
 *   - R019 vector Muls normalization
 *
 * No tile, UB, DMA, scheduling, reduction, or output conversion change.
 *
 * Core properties:
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - FP32 intermediates
 *   - ReduceSum unchanged
 *   - UB layout unchanged
 *   - row/core scheduling unchanged
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;
    static constexpr int32_t kParamCacheOffset = 4096;
    static constexpr uint64_t kParamCacheMaxWidth = 4096ULL;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x, GM_ADDR residual, GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias, GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(xBuf_, kTileElems * sizeof(T));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(residualBuf_, kTileElems * sizeof(T));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(xFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(residualFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(yFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(sumBuf_, kScalarElems * sizeof(float));

        if constexpr (!AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                gammaFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheOffset * sizeof(float));

            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                biasFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheOffset * sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup,
        uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        const uint64_t baseGroups =
            groupCount /
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t extraGroups =
            groupCount %
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginGroup =
            blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? blockIdx
                 : extraGroups);

        const uint64_t localGroups =
            baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? 1ULL
                 : 0ULL);

        const uint64_t endGroup =
            beginGroup +
            localGroups;

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            beginGroup *
            rowGroup;

        uint64_t endRow =
            endGroup *
            rowGroup;

        if (endRow > rowCount) {
            endRow = rowCount;
        }

        const uint64_t localRows =
            endRow > beginRow
                ? endRow - beginRow
                : 0ULL;

        const bool useParamCache =
            rowWidth <= kParamCacheMaxWidth &&
            localRows > 1ULL;

        if (useParamCache) {

            PrepareParameterCache(
                rowWidth);

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }

        } else {

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
        }
    }

private:

    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        kTileElems)
                ? kTileElems
                : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams
            copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    count *
                    static_cast<int32_t>(
                        sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

        const AscendC::
            DataCopyPadExtParams<T>
                padParams;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            copyParams,
            padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams
            copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    count *
                    static_cast<int32_t>(
                        sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::
                    CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void PrepareParameterCache(
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        Load(
            gammaCached,
            gammaGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        Load(
            biasCached,
            biasGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                gammaFp32 =
                    gammaFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                biasFp32 =
                    biasFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            ToFloat(
                gammaFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                biasFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void
    ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row *
            rowWidth;

        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            xFp32,
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::ReduceSum(
            partial,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            rms,
            rms,
            partial,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToMTE2();

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * R020-V001:
         *
         * sqrt + scalar reciprocal
         * becomes one vector Rsqrt.
         */
        AscendC::Rsqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        AscendC::Muls(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            invRms,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

        } else {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                gammaFp32 =
                    gammaFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                biasFp32 =
                    biasFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();
        }

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                xLocal,
                yFp32,
                AscendC::RoundMode::
                    CAST_RINT,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();
        }

        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row *
            rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth -
                    col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Rsqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth -
                    col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Muls(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                invRms,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<
                    T,
                    float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::
                        CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                    PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        yFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        sumBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        gammaFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        biasFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};

template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}

#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||

        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||

        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {

        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||

        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||

        residualInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        outputInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            residualInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            gammaInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            biasInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            outputInfo.dtype) {

        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {

        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned) {

            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                extentSigned);

        if (rowCount >
            maxU64 /
                extent) {

            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        rowCount == 0) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth >
            maxU64 /
                elementBytes ||
        rowCount >
            maxU64 /
                rowWidth) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth *
        elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA =
        rowBytes;

    uint64_t gcdB =
        32ULL;

    while (gcdB != 0ULL) {

        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA %
            gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32ULL /
        gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount /
            rowGroup +
        (rowCount %
                    rowGroup ==
                0ULL
             ? 0ULL
             : 1ULL);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks >
        groupCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            groupCount;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks >
        maxBlockCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0ULL) {
        requestedBlocks = 1ULL;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

---

# B. `R006-V001-PARTIALS`

这条只动宽行 fallback 的归约组织：

原来每个 tile：

```text
ReduceSum(tile)
→ Add(rms, partial)
→ 下一个 tile
```

改成：

```text
ReduceSum(tile0) → slot0
ReduceSum(tile1) → slot1
...
↓
最后一次 ReduceSum(slots)
```

激活范围先限制：

```text
8192 < D <= 65536
```

小 D、超大 D 全部保持 Parent。

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias - R006-V001-PARTIALS
 *
 * Parent: MIX-R014-R002-R019-V001
 * Status: candidate / not yet CANN-compiled or online tested here
 *
 * Single new mechanism:
 *   - for fallback rows with 8192 < D <= 65536, keep each tile's FP32
 *     ReduceSum result in sumBuf_ and reduce those partials once after
 *     the scan, instead of Add(rms, partial) after every tile.
 *
 * Existing mechanisms retained unchanged:
 *   - R014-V002 parameter residency
 *   - R002 retained-y fast path
 *   - R019 reciprocal + Muls normalization
 *
 * Rows outside the activation range use the parent path unchanged.
 *
 * Core properties:
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - FP32 intermediates
 *   - UB layout unchanged
 *   - row/core scheduling unchanged
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;
    static constexpr int32_t kParamCacheOffset = 4096;
    static constexpr uint64_t kParamCacheMaxWidth = 4096ULL;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xBuf_,
            kTileElems *
                sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualBuf_,
            kTileElems *
                sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems *
                sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems *
                sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            yFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems *
                sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            sumBuf_,
            kScalarElems *
                sizeof(float));

        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                gammaFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheOffset *
                    sizeof(float));

            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                biasFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheOffset *
                    sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup,
        uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        const uint64_t baseGroups =
            groupCount /
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t extraGroups =
            groupCount %
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginGroup =
            blockIdx *
                baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? blockIdx
                 : extraGroups);

        const uint64_t localGroups =
            baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                 ? 1ULL
                 : 0ULL);

        const uint64_t endGroup =
            beginGroup +
            localGroups;

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            beginGroup *
            rowGroup;

        uint64_t endRow =
            endGroup *
            rowGroup;

        if (endRow > rowCount) {
            endRow = rowCount;
        }

        const uint64_t localRows =
            endRow > beginRow
                ? endRow - beginRow
                : 0ULL;

        const bool useParamCache =
            rowWidth <=
                kParamCacheMaxWidth &&
            localRows > 1ULL;

        if (useParamCache) {

            PrepareParameterCache(
                rowWidth);

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }

        } else {

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
        }
    }

private:

    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        kTileElems)
                ? kTileElems
                : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams
            copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    count *
                    static_cast<int32_t>(
                        sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

        const AscendC::
            DataCopyPadExtParams<T>
                padParams;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            copyParams,
            padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams
            copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    count *
                    static_cast<int32_t>(
                        sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::
                    CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void PrepareParameterCache(
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        Load(
            gammaCached,
            gammaGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        Load(
            biasCached,
            biasGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                gammaFp32 =
                    gammaFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                biasFp32 =
                    biasFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            ToFloat(
                gammaFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                biasFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void
    ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row *
            rowWidth;

        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[
                kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            xFp32,
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::ReduceSum(
            partial,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            rms,
            rms,
            partial,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToMTE2();

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            1.0f /
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        AscendC::Muls(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            invRms,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

        } else {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                gammaFp32 =
                    gammaFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float>
                biasFp32 =
                    biasFp32Buf_
                        .Get<float>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();
        }

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                xLocal,
                yFp32,
                AscendC::RoundMode::
                    CAST_RINT,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();
        }

        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    /*
     * R006-V001 only changes this fallback wide-row reduction.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row *
            rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        /*
         * At 8192 elements/tile:
         *
         * D <= 65536
         * means <= 8 tile partials.
         *
         * sumSlots[0..7] = partials
         * sumSlots[8]    = final rms
         */
        const bool usePartialBatch =
            rowWidth >
                static_cast<uint64_t>(
                    kTileElems) &&
            rowWidth <=
                65536ULL;

        int32_t partialCount = 0;

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        /*
         * Pass 1.
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth -
                    col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            if (usePartialBatch) {

                /*
                 * New R006 path:
                 *
                 * store tile partial only.
                 */
                AscendC::ReduceSum(
                    sumSlots[
                        partialCount],
                    xFp32,
                    residualFp32,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                    PIPE_V>();

                ++partialCount;

            } else {

                /*
                 * Parent path unchanged.
                 */
                AscendC::ReduceSum(
                    partial,
                    xFp32,
                    residualFp32,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                    PIPE_V>();

                AscendC::Add(
                    rms,
                    rms,
                    partial,
                    1);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                    PIPE_V>();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        /*
         * New:
         *
         * combine <=8 partials once.
         */
        if (usePartialBatch) {

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                rms,
                sumSlots,
                residualFp32,
                partialCount);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<
            PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            1.0f /
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        /*
         * Pass 2 unchanged.
         */
        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth -
                    col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Muls(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                invRms,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<
                    T,
                    float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::
                        CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<
                    PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        yFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        sumBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        gammaFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        biasFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};

template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}

#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||

        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||

        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {

        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||

        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||

        residualInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        outputInfo.numDims !=
            xInfo.numDims ||

        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            residualInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            gammaInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            biasInfo.dtype ||

        xInfo.dtype !=
            outputInfo.dtype) {

        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {

        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] !=
            widthSigned) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] !=
                extentSigned) {

            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                extentSigned);

        if (rowCount >
            maxU64 /
                extent) {

            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||

        rowCount == 0) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth >
            maxU64 /
                elementBytes ||
        rowCount >
            maxU64 /
                rowWidth) {

        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth *
        elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA =
        rowBytes;

    uint64_t gcdB =
        32ULL;

    while (gcdB != 0ULL) {

        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA %
            gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32ULL /
        gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount /
            rowGroup +
        (rowCount %
                    rowGroup ==
                0ULL
             ? 0ULL
             : 1ULL);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks >
        groupCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            groupCount;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks >
        maxBlockCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0ULL) {
        requestedBlocks = 1ULL;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

        "brace_final": brace,
        "brace_min": min_brace,
