# A. R016-V001-TWO-GROUPS-PER-CORE

这条只改**分核调度**：

```text
D <= 4096
rowGroup == 1
Parent 原本会 1 group / core
        ↓
改成约 2 groups / active core
```

目的：让现有 `R014 parameter cache` 能跨两行复用。

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias - R016-V001-TWO-GROUPS-PER-CORE
 *
 * Parent: MIX-R014-R002-R019-V001
 * Status: candidate / not yet CANN-compiled or online tested here
 *
 * Single new mechanism:
 *   - scheduling only.
 *   - for D <= 4096, rowGroup == 1, and enough cores to otherwise assign
 *     exactly one row-group per core, launch ceil(groupCount / 2) cores.
 *   - this forces about two row-groups per active core, allowing the existing
 *     R014 parameter cache to be reused instead of paying one gamma/bias cache
 *     fill per single-row core.
 *
 * No kernel math, tile, UB, DMA, reduction, or normalization change.
 *
 * Core properties:
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - FP32 intermediates
 *   - ReduceSum unchanged
 *   - UB layout unchanged
 *   - only host-side active-core scheduling changes
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;
    static constexpr int32_t kParamCacheOffset = 4096;
    static constexpr uint64_t kParamCacheMaxWidth = 4096ULL;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x, GM_ADDR residual, GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias, GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(xBuf_, kTileElems * sizeof(T));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(residualBuf_, kTileElems * sizeof(T));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(xFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(residualFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(yFp32Buf_, kTileElems * sizeof(float));
        tpipe.InitBuffer(sumBuf_, kScalarElems * sizeof(float));

        if constexpr (!AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            tpipe.InitBuffer(gammaFp32Buf_, kParamCacheOffset * sizeof(float));
            tpipe.InitBuffer(biasFp32Buf_, kParamCacheOffset * sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount, uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup, uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount, float invRowWidth, float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx = static_cast<uint64_t>(AscendC::GetBlockIdx());
        const uint64_t baseGroups = groupCount / static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);
        const uint64_t extraGroups = groupCount % static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);
        const uint64_t beginGroup = blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups ? blockIdx : extraGroups);
        const uint64_t localGroups = baseGroups + (blockIdx < extraGroups ? 1ULL : 0ULL);
        const uint64_t endGroup = beginGroup + localGroups;
        const uint64_t beginRow = beginGroup * rowGroup;
        uint64_t endRow = endGroup * rowGroup;
        if (endRow > rowCount) endRow = rowCount;

        const uint64_t localRows = endRow > beginRow ? endRow - beginRow : 0ULL;
        const bool useParamCache = rowWidth <= kParamCacheMaxWidth && localRows > 1ULL;

        if (useParamCache) {
            PrepareParameterCache(rowWidth);
            for (uint64_t row = beginRow; row < endRow; ++row) {
                ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(row, rowWidth, invRowWidth, epsilon);
            }
        } else {
            for (uint64_t row = beginRow; row < endRow; ++row) {
                ProcessRow(row, rowWidth, invRowWidth, epsilon);
            }
        }
    }

private:
    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain > static_cast<uint64_t>(kTileElems) ? kTileElems : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset, int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
            0, 0, 0);

        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padParams;
        AscendC::DataCopyPad(dst, src[offset], copyParams, padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
            0, 0, 0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(dst[offset], src, copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Adds(dst, src, 0.0f, count);
        } else {
            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void PrepareParameterCache(uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        const int32_t valid = static_cast<int32_t>(rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal = xBuf_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal = residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        Load(gammaCached, gammaGm_, 0, valid);
        Load(biasCached, biasGm_, 0, valid);
        SyncMTE2ToV();

        if constexpr (!AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaFp32 =
                gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
                biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            ToFloat(gammaFp32, gammaCached, valid);
            ToFloat(biasFp32, biasCached, valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset = row * rowWidth;
        const int32_t valid = static_cast<int32_t>(rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal = xBuf_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal = residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(rms, 0.0f, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        Load(xLocal, xGm_, rowOffset, valid);
        Load(residualLocal, residualGm_, rowOffset, valid);
        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(xFp32, xLocal, valid);
        ToFloat(residualFp32, residualLocal, valid);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(yFp32, xFp32, residualFp32, valid);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(xFp32, yFp32, yFp32, valid);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::ReduceSum(
            partial,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(rms, rms, partial, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToMTE2();

        AscendC::Muls(rms, rms, invRowWidth, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(rms, rms, epsilon, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(rms, rms, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            1.0f / rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        AscendC::Muls(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            invRms,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        if constexpr (AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        } else {
            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaFp32 =
                gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
                biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }

        if constexpr (AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();

        } else {
            AscendC::Cast(
                xLocal,
                yFp32,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();
        }

        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset = row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(rms, 0.0f, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(xFp32, xLocal, valid);
            ToFloat(residualFp32, residualLocal, valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            1.0f / rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(xFp32, xLocal, valid);
            ToFloat(residualFp32, residualLocal, valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Muls(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                invRms,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(xFp32, xLocal, valid);
            ToFloat(residualFp32, residualLocal, valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {
                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> xBuf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> residualBuf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> xFp32Buf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> residualFp32Buf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> yFp32Buf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> sumBuf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> gammaFp32Buf_;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> biasFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};

template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}

#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||
        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {
        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||
        residualInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        outputInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        xInfo.dtype != residualInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != gammaInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != biasInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != outputInfo.dtype) {
        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {
        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned) {
            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(extentSigned);

        if (rowCount > maxU64 / extent) {
            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned ||
        outputInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned ||
        rowCount == 0) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth > maxU64 / elementBytes ||
        rowCount > maxU64 / rowWidth) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth * elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA = rowBytes;
    uint64_t gcdB = 32ULL;

    while (gcdB != 0ULL) {
        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA % gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32ULL / gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount / rowGroup +
        (rowCount % rowGroup == 0ULL
            ? 0ULL
            : 1ULL);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks > groupCount) {
        requestedBlocks = groupCount;
    }

    /*
     * R016-V001:
     * only scheduling changes here.
     */
    if (rowWidth <= 4096ULL &&
        rowGroup == 1ULL &&
        groupCount > 1ULL &&
        requestedBlocks == groupCount) {

        requestedBlocks =
            (groupCount + 1ULL) / 2ULL;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks > maxBlockCount) {
        requestedBlocks = maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0ULL) {
        requestedBlocks = 1ULL;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

---

# B. R030-V001-WIDE-LOWP-PARAM-BATCH2

这条只改**宽行低精度参数复用**：

```text
FP16/BF16
D > 4096
localRows >= 2

gamma/bias tile
只搬一次 + 只转 FP32 一次
        ↓
同时给 row0 + row1 使用
```

RMS 仍然每行单独按 Parent 算。

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias - R030-V001-WIDE-LOWP-PARAM-BATCH2
 *
 * Parent: MIX-R014-R002-R019-V001
 * Status: candidate / not yet CANN-compiled or online tested here
 *
 * Single new mechanism:
 *   - for FP16/BF16 fallback rows with D > 4096 and at least two local rows,
 *     process rows in pairs during the output pass.
 *   - gamma/bias are loaded and converted to FP32 once per 4096-element
 *     parameter tile, then reused for both rows.
 *
 * RMS math remains identical to the parent and is computed independently
 * for each row before the paired output pass.
 *
 * No reduction algorithm, normalization formula, row ownership, or final
 * rounding change.
 *
 * Core properties:
 *   - kTileElems = 8192
 *   - FP32 intermediates
 *   - ReduceSum unchanged
 *   - UB layout unchanged
 *   - row/core scheduling unchanged
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kTileElems = 8192;
    static constexpr int32_t kParamCacheOffset = 4096;
    static constexpr uint64_t kParamCacheMaxWidth = 4096ULL;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;
    static constexpr int32_t kWideParamBatchTileElems = 4096;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualBuf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(T));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            xFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            residualFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            yFp32Buf_,
            kTileElems * sizeof(float));

        tpipe.InitBuffer(
            sumBuf_,
            kScalarElems * sizeof(float));

        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {

            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                gammaFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheOffset * sizeof(float));

            tpipe.InitBuffer(
                biasFp32Buf_,
                kParamCacheOffset * sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowGroup,
        uint64_t groupCount,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        const uint64_t baseGroups =
            groupCount /
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t extraGroups =
            groupCount %
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginGroup =
            blockIdx * baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                ? blockIdx
                : extraGroups);

        const uint64_t localGroups =
            baseGroups +
            (blockIdx < extraGroups
                ? 1ULL
                : 0ULL);

        const uint64_t endGroup =
            beginGroup + localGroups;

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            beginGroup * rowGroup;

        uint64_t endRow =
            endGroup * rowGroup;

        if (endRow > rowCount) {
            endRow = rowCount;
        }

        const uint64_t localRows =
            endRow > beginRow
                ? endRow - beginRow
                : 0ULL;

        /*
         * R030-V001:
         * low-precision wide pairwise parameter reuse.
         */
        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {

            if (rowWidth > kParamCacheMaxWidth &&
                localRows >= 2ULL) {

                uint64_t row = beginRow;

                for (;
                     row + 1ULL < endRow;
                     row += 2ULL) {

                    ProcessWideLowPrecisionParamBatch2(
                        row,
                        row + 1ULL,
                        rowWidth,
                        invRowWidth,
                        epsilon);
                }

                if (row < endRow) {
                    ProcessRow(
                        row,
                        rowWidth,
                        invRowWidth,
                        epsilon);
                }

                return;
            }
        }

        const bool useParamCache =
            rowWidth <= kParamCacheMaxWidth &&
            localRows > 1ULL;

        if (useParamCache) {

            PrepareParameterCache(
                rowWidth);

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }

        } else {

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {

                ProcessRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
        }
    }

private:

    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remain) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remain >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        kTileElems)
                ? kTileElems
                : remain);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Load(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams
            copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    count *
                    static_cast<int32_t>(
                        sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

        const AscendC::
            DataCopyPadExtParams<T>
                padParams;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            copyParams,
            padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams
            copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    count *
                    static_cast<int32_t>(
                        sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            copyParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFloat(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<
                T,
                float>::value) {

            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::
                    CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE2ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToMTE3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMTE3ToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVToS()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncSToV()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);

        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    /*
     * Parent RMS calculation extracted as a helper.
     */
    __aicore__ inline float ComputeInvRmsForRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(
                    rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            1.0f /
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        return invRms;
    }

    __aicore__ inline void
    ProcessWideLowPrecisionOutputTile(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t col,
        int32_t valid,
        float invRms)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaFp32 =
            gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
            biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset + col,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset + col,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Muls(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            invRms,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            gammaFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            biasFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Cast(
            xLocal,
            yFp32,
            AscendC::RoundMode::
                CAST_RINT,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToMTE3();

        Store(
            outputGm_,
            rowOffset + col,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        SyncMTE3ToV();
        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    __aicore__ inline void
    ProcessWideLowPrecisionParamBatch2(
        uint64_t row0,
        uint64_t row1,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const float invRms0 =
            ComputeInvRmsForRow(
                row0,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

        const float invRms1 =
            ComputeInvRmsForRow(
                row1,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaFp32 =
            gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
            biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col +=
                 static_cast<uint64_t>(
                     kWideParamBatchTileElems)) {

            const uint64_t remain =
                rowWidth - col;

            const int32_t valid =
                static_cast<int32_t>(
                    remain >
                            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                                kWideParamBatchTileElems)
                        ? kWideParamBatchTileElems
                        : remain);

            /*
             * Parameter GM load only once for two rows.
             */
            Load(
                gammaLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                biasLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                gammaFp32,
                gammaLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                biasFp32,
                biasLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            ProcessWideLowPrecisionOutputTile(
                row0,
                rowWidth,
                col,
                valid,
                invRms0);

            ProcessWideLowPrecisionOutputTile(
                row1,
                rowWidth,
                col,
                valid,
                invRms1);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void PrepareParameterCache(
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        Load(
            gammaCached,
            gammaGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        Load(
            biasCached,
            biasGm_,
            0,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        if constexpr (
            !AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaFp32 =
                gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
                biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            ToFloat(
                gammaFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                biasFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void
    ProcessCachedParamsRetainedYRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        const int32_t valid =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                rowWidth);

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaCached =
            xLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasCached =
            residualLocal[kParamCacheOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        Load(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        Load(
            residualLocal,
            residualGm_,
            rowOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMTE2ToV();

        ToFloat(
            xFp32,
            xLocal,
            valid);

        ToFloat(
            residualFp32,
            residualLocal,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            yFp32,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Mul(
            xFp32,
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::ReduceSum(
            partial,
            xFp32,
            residualFp32,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Add(
            rms,
            rms,
            partial,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToMTE2();

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            1.0f /
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        AscendC::Muls(
            yFp32,
            yFp32,
            invRms,
            valid);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasCached,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        } else {

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaFp32 =
                gammaFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
                biasFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                gammaFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                biasFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();

        } else {

            AscendC::Cast(
                xLocal,
                yFp32,
                AscendC::RoundMode::
                    CAST_RINT,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE3();

            Store(
                outputGm_,
                rowOffset,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            SyncMTE3ToV();
        }

        SyncVToMTE2();
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> residualLocal =
            residualBuf_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 =
            xFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> residualFp32 =
            residualFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> yFp32 =
            yFp32Buf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> sumSlots =
            sumBuf_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            sumSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rms =
            sumSlots[8];

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rms,
            0.0f,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                xFp32,
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rms,
                rms,
                partial,
                1);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rms,
            rms,
            invRowWidth,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rms,
            rms,
            epsilon,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rms,
            rms,
            1);

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVToS();

        const float invRms =
            1.0f /
            rms.GetValue(0);

        SyncSToV();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += kTileElems) {

            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            Load(
                xLocal,
                xGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                residualGm_,
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Muls(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                invRms,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVToMTE2();

            Load(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            Load(
                residualLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMTE2ToV();

            ToFloat(
                xFp32,
                xLocal,
                valid);

            ToFloat(
                residualFp32,
                residualLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                xFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                yFp32,
                yFp32,
                residualFp32,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    yFp32,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();

            } else {

                AscendC::Cast(
                    xLocal,
                    yFp32,
                    AscendC::RoundMode::
                        CAST_RINT,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVToMTE3();

                Store(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMTE3ToV();
            }

            SyncVToMTE2();
        }
    }

private:

    AscendC::TPipe tpipe;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        residualFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        yFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        sumBuf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        gammaFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        biasFp32Buf_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;
};

template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_custom(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint64_t rowGroup,
    uint64_t groupCount,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    AddRmsNormBiasKernel<T> op;

    op.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output);

    op.Process(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        rowGroup,
        groupCount,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}

#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)

extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,

    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,

    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,

    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,

    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,

    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||
        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {
        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];

    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||
        residualInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        outputInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        xInfo.dtype != residualInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != gammaInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != biasInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != outputInfo.dtype) {
        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {
        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {

        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residualInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned) {
            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                extentSigned);

        if (rowCount > maxU64 / extent) {
            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||
        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] !=
            widthSigned ||
        rowCount == 0) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            widthSigned);

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0
            ? 4ULL
            : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth >
            maxU64 /
                elementBytes ||
        rowCount >
            maxU64 /
                rowWidth) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth *
        elementBytes;

    uint64_t gcdA =
        rowBytes;

    uint64_t gcdB =
        32ULL;

    while (gcdB != 0ULL) {

        const uint64_t remainder =
            gcdA %
            gcdB;

        gcdA = gcdB;
        gcdB = remainder;
    }

    const uint64_t rowGroup =
        32ULL /
        gcdA;

    const uint64_t groupCount =
        rowCount /
            rowGroup +
        (rowCount %
                    rowGroup ==
                0ULL
             ? 0ULL
             : 1ULL);

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks >
        groupCount) {
        requestedBlocks =
            groupCount;
    }

    const uint64_t maxBlockCount =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU);

    if (requestedBlocks >
        maxBlockCount) {
        requestedBlocks =
            maxBlockCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0ULL) {
        requestedBlocks = 1ULL;
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

    } else {

        add_rms_norm_bias_custom<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                rowGroup,
                groupCount,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}

#endif
```

## 为什么现在值得直接这么干

你之前给的已知优化参考本身就已经不是一条单路径 Kernel，而是显式存在：

- `wideFp32BatchPath_`
- `wideFp32CachedRowPath_`
- `wideFp16CachedRowPath_`
- `wideBf16CachedRowPath_`

并根据 row 数、dtype 和宽度选择不同 UB 布局。fileciteturn17file0L7-L34

其中 FP16 wide cached 路径会缓存完整行，而 BF16 也采用紧凑缓存来避免第二次输入读取。fileciteturn18file0L16-L94

更关键的是，这套参考架构已有一组 **15/15 Pass** 的真实结果：

```text
Case 6  32.19 μs
Case 8  69.54 μs
Case 10 74.15 μs
Case 14 16.5 ms
Case 15  9.65 ms
```

fileciteturn20file0L21-L41

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * R031-V001-FULL-MULTIMODE-REWRITE
 *
 * Clean-slate architecture reset.
 * This version does NOT inherit the previous R029/R016/R030 implementation.
 * It uses a multi-mode runtime dispatcher with separate small-row, wide-row,
 * dtype-specific cached-row, parameter-reuse, batching and pipelined paths.
 *
 * Purpose: test whether a large architectural reset can close the multi-x
 * gap to TBest that local branch tuning could not address.
 */

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias Kernel — Ascend C Direct Invocation
 */

template <typename T>
class AddRmsNormBiasKernel {
public:
    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint32_t blockCount)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)output);

        widePath_ = false;
        wideFp32BatchPath_ = false;
        wideFp32CachedRowPath_ = false;
        wideFp16CachedRowPath_ = false;
        wideBf16CachedRowPath_ = false;

        // 后续进入完整的 shape/dtype-aware 多模式分派……
```

这里我没有再从当前 29 分代码复制然后修改几个函数，而是**把旧架构整个放到旁支，把 R031 作为新的独立根节点**。

哪怕第一次 Score 还没直接到 70，我们也已经找到正确架构，后续就应该：

```text
 └─ wide BF16 路径继续调
```

而不再回到旧 `R029` 树。

那说明：

> 仅靠这套参考多模式架构仍然不够，真正 70 分方案还有更强的 tiling / core scheduling / pipeline 或 launch 结构。

届时我们再做 **R032 第二维度的 clean-slate rewrite**，而不是继续修 R031 小参数。

## [1256] assistant · 2026-09-17 17:29:51
message_reaction👀你之前定的并不是“找到一个当前最好版本就一直往下改”，而是一套 **树形、分阶段、可归因的系统探索流程**。这套流程比我们最近几轮的局部推进更严格，我把它恢复成完整版本。

## 1. 你最开始要求的总流程

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["0. 固定基线 / Golden / 评测口径"]
    --> B["1. 建立技术路线树"]

    B --> C1["计算 / 数学"]
    B --> C2["Reduction"]
    B --> C3["UB / Tile / Cache"]
    B --> C4["DMA / 搬运 / Tail"]
    B --> C5["多核 / 调度"]
    B --> C6["Pipeline / Double Buffer"]
    B --> C7["dtype / 精度"]
    B --> C8["Shape-aware / Runtime Routing"]

    C1 --> D["2. 每条支线先做 V001"]
    C2 --> D
    C3 --> D
    C4 --> D
    C5 --> D
    C6 --> D
    C7 --> D
    C8 --> D

    D --> E["候选先保存源码 + SHA/Git commit"]
    E --> F["静态检查"]
    F --> G["CANN 编译"]
    G --> H["服务器 NPU 验证"]
    H --> I["Online Judge"]

    I --> J{"Correctness 通过？"}

    J -- "否" --> K["记录失败原因<br/>保留失败节点<br/>原则上不深挖"]
    J -- "是" --> L["记录 Score + 15 Case + 基线提升"]

    K --> M["继续下一条未探索支线"]
    L --> M

    M --> N{"主要支线是否都至少探索一次？"}

    N -- "否" --> D

    N -- "是" --> O["3. 第一轮横向比较"]
    O --> P["选高分 / 高潜力 / Case互补的路线"]

    P --> Q["4. 各优秀支线内部独立深挖<br/>V002 / V003 / ..."]
    Q --> R["形成路线级 Checkpoint"]

    R --> S["5. 两两组合 / 正交机制 Mix"]
    S --> T{"组合是否有叠加收益？"}

    T -- "否" --> U["保留独立 Checkpoint<br/>记录负交互"]
    T -- "是" --> V["形成组合 Checkpoint"]

    U --> W["6. 多模式 Runtime Router"]
    V --> W

    W --> X["按 dtype / D / rows/core / shape<br/>选择不同最优路径"]

    X --> Y["7. 最终综合版本"]
```

核心就是：

> **先横向探索，后纵向深挖；先独立验证，后组合；最后才做多模式融合。**

这也是为什么你前面提醒我“先把每条支线都推进一次，再选高分支线优化或者混合”是对的。

---

# 2. 最重要的实验纪律

### ① 一条路线必须能单独归因

原则：

```text
一个版本 = 一个主要技术假设
```

例如：

```text
R014-V001
只验证 parameter residency

R019-V001
只验证 reciprocal + Muls

R016-V001
只验证 core scheduling
```

不能一版同时：

```text
改 Tile
+ 改 Reduction
+ 改 Core
+ 改 Cast
+ 改 DMA
```

否则即使涨 10 分，也不知道是谁贡献的。

你之前的候选文件也是按照这种“single mechanism delta”记录的。fileciteturn6file5

---

## ② 各支线要真正独立

不是：

```text
当前 Champion
   ↓
改 A
   ↓
改 B
   ↓
改 C
```

这样会变成一条长链。

而应该：

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    B["Common Baseline / Checkpoint"]

    B --> A["Route A"]
    B --> C["Route B"]
    B --> D["Route C"]
    B --> E["Route D"]

    A --> A2["A-V002"]
    C --> C2["C-V002"]

    A2 --> MIX["A + C Mix"]
    C2 --> MIX
```

也就是：

> **没有“当前 Champion 门槛”。弱路线也允许独立完成第一次实验。**

因为某条路线单独只涨一点，但可能与另一条路线高度正交，组合后反而很强。

---

# 3. 第一阶段的真正目标不是“立刻涨分”

第一阶段应该叫：

## Breadth Exploration / 广度探索

目标是回答：

```text
哪些技术有效？
哪些无效？
哪些有 correctness 风险？
哪些只改善特定 Case？
哪些与其他技术可能正交？
```

因此：

```text
28.5
28.8
29.0
```

不代表实验没意义。

只要它完成了一条新的技术轴，我们就得到了一条信息。

正确状态应该是：

| 结果 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| Correctness Fail | 记录失败，通常冻结 |
| Pass + 明显变慢 | Reject / 冻结 |
| Pass + 中性 | 保留证据，冻结 |
| Pass + 弱正收益 | Candidate |
| Pass + 强正收益 | 高优先级 Checkpoint |
| 特定 Case 大幅改善 | 保留，未来适合 Runtime Routing |

---

# 4. 什么时候才能在一条支线上继续 V002/V003

你之前的规则实际是：

> **主要技术路线第一轮至少跑过之后，再比较。**

然后再选：

```text
Top Score
+
高潜力路线
+
改善 Case 与别人不同的路线
```

做：

```text
Rxxx-V002
Rxxx-V003
Rxxx-V004
```

而不是因为某个 V001 临时最好，就马上连续写四五版。

我们前面的：

```text
R029-V001
R029-V002
R029-V003
R029-V004
```

其实就已经有点偏离这个节奏了。

---

# 5. 混合优化的规则

这个也是你之前特别强调过的。

## 必须先独立验证

正确：

```text
A 独立 Pass
B 独立 Pass

↓

A + B
```

错误：

```text
A 未测试
B 未测试

↓

直接 A+B+C
```

否则完全无法做 ablation。

你之前的 R029-V004 就遵守了这个逻辑：只组合已经分别在线验证过的 FP16 / BF16 路径，而没有把未独立验证的 FP32 路径强行塞进去。fileciteturn6file8

---

## 组合不只看“谁分最高”

更应该看 **正交性**。

例如：

```text
A：减少 GM Read
B：减少 Scalar Sync
C：改善 Core Occupancy
D：减少 Cast
```

即使：

```text
A = +8%
B = +3%
C = +4%
```

`A + C` 可能比 `A + B` 更值得做，因为优化的瓶颈不同。

所以第二阶段选组合时要看：

```text
官方 Score
+
Per-case delta
+
技术正交性
+
是否作用于不同 shape/dtype
```

---

# 6. 最终不是“一条万能 Kernel”

你原来这个探索流程最终其实天然指向：

## Shape-aware Multi-mode Router

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    INPUT["dtype + D + rowCount + rows/core"]

    INPUT --> Q1{"Small / Wide?"}

    Q1 -->|Small| S["Small-row modes"]
    Q1 -->|Wide| W["Wide-row modes"]

    S --> S1["FP32 Batch"]
    S --> S2["FP16 Batch"]
    S --> S3["BF16 Batch"]
    S --> S4["Parameter Residency"]

    W --> W1["FP32 Cached"]
    W --> W2["FP32 Batch"]
    W --> W3["FP16 Cached"]
    W --> W4["BF16 Cached"]
    W --> W5["Streaming / Pipeline"]

    S1 --> OUT["Output"]
    S2 --> OUT
    S3 --> OUT
    S4 --> OUT
    W1 --> OUT
    W2 --> OUT
    W3 --> OUT
    W4 --> OUT
    W5 --> OUT
```

也就是说最终可以吸收多个路线，但这些路线之前都应该有自己的独立实验依据。

你之前给的高性能参考本身也是这样的多模式 dispatcher，而不是单一路径。fileciteturn6file0

---

# 7. Correctness 是硬门槛

这一点一直不能变：

```text
Static Check
≠
CANN Compile
≠
Server NPU Pass
≠
Online Judge Pass
```

最终权威：

> **Online Judge。**

正式可接受路线首先必须线上 correctness 通过。fileciteturn6file6

所以以后结果必须明确区分：

```text
Static: PASS/FAIL
CANN Compile: PASS/FAIL/未测
Server NPU: PASS/FAIL/未测
Online: 15/15 / WA / Runtime Error
```

不能用“静态没问题”描述成“代码可用”。

---

# 8. 失败也必须进入树

失败不能删除。

例如：

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    R020["R020 Rsqrt"]
    R020 --> V1["V001"]
    V1 --> WA["WA<br/>Case2-15 incorrect"]
    WA --> FREEZE["Frozen<br/>保留证据"]
```

原因是以后我们需要知道：

```text
这个技术试过了吗？
怎么失败的？
是 compile fail？
correctness fail？
还是 performance regression？
```

否则过几十轮后很容易重复走同一个坑。

---

# 9. 每一次实验需要绑定源码

你之前要求的可追溯流程应该固定成：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    CODE["生成候选源码"]
    --> HASH["SHA256 / Git Commit"]
    --> BUILD["CANN Compile"]
    --> NPU["NPU"]
    --> ONLINE["Online"]
    --> RECORD["Result Record"]

    RECORD --> CODE
```

即：

> **候选先固定，再实验。**

不能：

```text
提交了
↓
回来以后源码又改过
↓
却继续把结果记到同一个版本名
```

每个正式实验至少绑定：

```text
Route ID
Version
Parent
唯一 Delta
SHA256 / commit
提交时间
Online Score
15 Case
Correctness
结论
```

---

# 10. 现在的分数记录口径

这一点和更早期文档相比，我们后面已经根据平台结果修正过。

现在固定区分 **两个东西**。

### A. 官方 Score

直接记录 CANNJudge：

```text
Score = 平台显示值
```

例如：

```text
R029-V004 = 29.01
R006-V001 = 28.80
R016-V001 = 28.72
```

**禁止再自己复算一个值然后叫“官方 Score”。**

---

### B. 固定初始基线提升

仍然作为辅助指标：

\[
Improvement=
\frac{T_{baseline}-T_{candidate}}
     {T_{baseline}}
\times100\%
\]

固定基线：

```text
Case1~15:
4.33μs
11.96μs
8.98μs
97.36μs
14.02μs
122.74μs
239.20μs
401.84μs
191.36μs
323.92μs
258.44μs
251.22μs
758.78μs
125ms
11.3ms
```

总计：

```text
138,984.15 μs
```

它只回答：

> 相对我们最开始版本整体快了多少。

而不能替代平台 Score。

---

# 11. 还必须记录 Per-Case

这个现在尤其重要，因为 TBest 已经给我们明确目标。

每次都应该生成：

| Case | Candidate | TBest | Candidate/TBest | 相比 Parent |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

这样才能识别：

```text
Case14 → 大 batch 瓶颈
Case8 → 某种宽行瓶颈
Case2 → small-row overhead
...
```

但注意：

> **不能仅根据 timing 猜隐藏 dtype / shape。**

没有明确数据就只能说：

```text
“Case 14 显示这一测试点仍有巨大性能差距”
```

不能写：

```text
“Case14 一定是 BF16 32768×xxxx”
```

除非我们有题目数据或 profiling 证据。

---

# 12. 文档更新要求

每次收到线上结果以后，不只是回复一句分数。

要同步更新：

```text
CURRENT_STATE
RESULT_RECORD
探索树
路线状态
Champion
SHA256
下一候选
完整 package
```

树节点至少包含：

```text
✓ Pass
✗ Correctness Fail
△ Performance Reject
★ Checkpoint
❄ Frozen
? Untested
```

---

# 13. 代码要求

你后面又明确补了一条：

> **所有下一版本，都直接在对话里给完整 `kernel.asc`。**

所以以后不应该只给：

```text
[下载 kernel.asc]
```

而应该：

```text
先直接贴完整代码
+
可选下载文件/归档作为备份
```

---

# 14. 我们现在应该恢复成的主流程

结合目前已经积累的结果，接下来应该这样走：

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["当前已有大量 V001 / 路线结果"]

    A --> B["整理完整 Route Matrix"]

    B --> C{"还有主要性能轴完全没探索？"}

    C -- "有" --> D["继续 Breadth Exploration<br/>每次可并行 2~3 条独立支线"]
    D --> B

    C -- "没有" --> E["第一轮路线比较"]

    E --> F["选 2~4 条高价值路线"]
    F --> G1["路线 A 深挖"]
    F --> G2["路线 B 深挖"]
    F --> G3["路线 C 深挖"]

    G1 --> H1["Checkpoint A"]
    G2 --> H2["Checkpoint B"]
    G3 --> H3["Checkpoint C"]

    H1 --> I["Pairwise Mix"]
    H2 --> I
    H3 --> I

    I --> J["记录正交 / 冲突关系"]

    J --> K["Shape/dtype-aware Multi-mode"]
    K --> L["Final architecture"]
```

而 **R031 这种“大范围重写”可以保留为另一条独立架构路线**，但它不应该把前面的探索树全部抹掉。

准确说：

```text
旧树 = 技术机制实验库
R031 = Clean-slate Architecture Branch
```

两者应该并存。

---

## 一句话恢复你最初的要求

> **树形而非线性；广度优先于深度；每个机制先独立跑；一个版本一个主要变量；线上 correctness 是硬门槛；失败也留档；所有源码和结果可追溯；第一轮全部探索后再选优质支线深挖；独立验证完成后才做组合；最终通过 shape/dtype/runtime routing 把各路线的局部最优合并成最终 Kernel。**

后续我会按这套流程继续，不再因为某一次结果或某个当前 Champion 临时改变整个实验策略。memcite

Parent：

```text
R031-V001-FULL-MULTIMODE-REWRITE
```

只有一个新的主要变量：

```text
非 wide row
        ↓
计算 rowBytes
        ↓
rowGroup = 32 / gcd(rowBytes, 32)
        ↓
以完整 32B 对齐 row-group 为单位分配 Vector Core
```

例如理论上：

```text
FP16 rowBytes = 2B
→ 16 rows/group

FP32 rowBytes = 4B
→ 8 rows/group

已经 32B 对齐
→ 1 row/group
```

而且这一版明确规定：

```text
D > 8192 的 R031 wide family
完全不改调度
```

因此不会把 R031 当前最重要的 wide multi-mode 结构一起改掉。

# 3. 下一条：`R009-V001-ALIGNED-DATACOPY-FASTPATH`

这一版重新从 **R031-V001** 分叉，而不是从退化的 R012 继续。

唯一假设：

```text
32B 对齐搬运
DataCopyPad
    ↓
DataCopy
```

非对齐尾块仍然：

```text
DataCopyPad
```

官方 Ascend C 文档说明，普通连续 `DataCopy` 的搬运量要求为 32 byte 的倍数；非对齐搬运应使用相应非对齐处理方式。citeturn485704search0turn485704search1

所以这一版实际上测试的是：

> **R031 中大量已经天然 32B 对齐的主干 DMA，是否因为统一走 `DataCopyPad` 存在额外开销。**

它不改：

```text
数学
Reduction
Tile
UB layout
Core scheduling
dtype router
Wide cached path
Batch path
Pipeline
```

因此归因很干净。

## 核心唯一修改

R031 原本：

```cpp
__aicore__ inline void Load(
    const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
    const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
    uint64_t offset,
    int32_t count)
{
    const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
        1,
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
        0,
        0,
        0);

    const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padParams;

    AscendC::DataCopyPad(
        dst,
        src[offset],
        copyParams,
        padParams);
}
```

变为：

```cpp
__aicore__ inline void Load(
    const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
    const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
    uint64_t offset,
    int32_t count)
{
    const uint32_t byteCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T)));

    if ((byteCount & 31U) == 0U) {
        AscendC::DataCopy(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            count);
        return;
    }

    const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
        1,
        byteCount,
        0,
        0,
        0);

    const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padParams;

    AscendC::DataCopyPad(
        dst,
        src[offset],
        copyParams,
        padParams);
}
```

Store 同理：

```cpp
__aicore__ inline void Store(
    const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
    uint64_t offset,
    const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
    int32_t count)
{
    const uint32_t byteCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T)));

    if ((byteCount & 31U) == 0U) {
        AscendC::DataCopy(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            count);
        return;
    }

    const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
        1,
        byteCount,
        0,
        0,
        0);

    AscendC::DataCopyPad(
        dst[offset],
        src,
        copyParams);
}
```

这符合普通 `DataCopy` 对连续搬运长度的 32B 对齐要求；文档也明确给出了 `DataCopy(dst, src, calCount)` 的连续搬运形式。citeturn485704search1turn133500search3

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, zipfile, shutil

parent = Path("/mnt/data/R031-V001-FULL-MULTIMODE-REWRITE_kernel.asc")
text = parent.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

text = text.replace(
    "R031-V001-FULL-MULTIMODE-REWRITE",
    "R010-V001-SPLIT-ALIGNED-PREFIX-TAIL",
    1
)

old_header = """ * Purpose: test whether a large architectural reset can close the multi-x
 * gap to TBest that local branch tuning could not address.
 */
"""
new_header = """ * Parent: R031-V001-FULL-MULTIMODE-REWRITE
 * Breadth-exploration route: R010 / manual split tail.
 *
 * Single new mechanism:
 *   - for a non-32-byte-aligned GM<->UB transfer, split it into:
 *       1) the largest 32-byte-aligned prefix via AscendC::DataCopy;
 *       2) only the final short tail via AscendC::DataCopyPad.
 *   - naturally aligned transfers remain one AscendC::DataCopy.
 *
 * Everything else is inherited from validated R031:
 *   - dtype/shape routing
 *   - UB layout
 *   - reduction math
 *   - core scheduling
 *   - cached/batched/pipelined paths
 *
 * This is an independent breadth experiment, not a deep R031 tune.
 */
"""
if old_header not in text:
    raise RuntimeError("header marker not found")
text = text.replace(old_header, new_header, 1)

old_helpers = """    __aicore__ inline void Load(const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
                                const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
                                uint64_t offset, int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1, static_cast<uint32_t>(count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))), 0, 0, 0);
        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padParams;
        AscendC::DataCopyPad(dst, src[offset], copyParams, padParams);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst, uint64_t offset,
                                 const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src, int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
            1, static_cast<uint32_t>(count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))), 0, 0, 0);
        AscendC::DataCopyPad(dst[offset], src, copyParams);
    }
"""
new_helpers = """    __aicore__ inline void Load(const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
                                const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
                                uint64_t offset, int32_t count)
    {
        /*
         * R010-V001 manual split-tail path.
         *
         * Keep the long naturally aligned part on DataCopy and confine
         * DataCopyPad to the final <32-byte fragment.  This preserves exact
         * row-boundary behavior while testing whether a whole non-aligned
         * DataCopyPad transfer is unnecessarily expensive.
         */
        const uint32_t byteCount =
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T)));

        const uint32_t alignedBytes = byteCount & ~31U;
        const int32_t alignedElems =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                alignedBytes / static_cast<uint32_t>(sizeof(T)));

        if (alignedElems > 0) {
            AscendC::DataCopy(
                dst,
                src[offset],
                alignedElems);
        }

        const int32_t tailElems = count - alignedElems;
        if (tailElems > 0) {
            const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    tailElems * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

            const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padParams;

            AscendC::DataCopyPad(
                dst[alignedElems],
                src[offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(alignedElems)],
                copyParams,
                padParams);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Store(const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
                                 uint64_t offset,
                                 const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
                                 int32_t count)
    {
        const uint32_t byteCount =
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T)));

        const uint32_t alignedBytes = byteCount & ~31U;
        const int32_t alignedElems =
            static_cast<int32_t>(
                alignedBytes / static_cast<uint32_t>(sizeof(T)));

        if (alignedElems > 0) {
            AscendC::DataCopy(
                dst[offset],
                src,
                alignedElems);
        }

        const int32_t tailElems = count - alignedElems;
        if (tailElems > 0) {
            const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams(
                1,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(
                    tailElems * static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
                0,
                0,
                0);

            AscendC::DataCopyPad(
                dst[offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(alignedElems)],
                src[alignedElems],
                copyParams);
        }
    }
"""
if old_helpers not in text:
    raise RuntimeError("original Load/Store block not found")
text = text.replace(old_helpers, new_helpers, 1)

out = Path("/mnt/data/R010-V001-SPLIT-ALIGNED-PREFIX-TAIL_kernel.asc")
out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

brace=0; bmin=0
for ch in text:
    if ch=="{": brace += 1

# 每条路线以后都必须“路线拥有整个版本”


### Pure R006

```text

其他缓存 / batch / routing 全部不参与
```

## `B0-PURE-V001`

上面已经把 **完整 418 行源码直接贴在对话中**。

这一步必须先做，因为后续：

```text
B0-PURE
├── PURE-R006

```

都需要从**同一个线上测过的干净 Parent** 分叉，否则又会出现“名义上测 R010，实际上主要性能来自 R031”的问题。

### 这一版刻意没有

```text
✗ retained-y
✗ parameter cache
✗ multi-row batch
✗ wide cached row
✗ multimode router
✗ double buffer
✗ pipeline
✗ manual tail
✗ aligned DataCopy fast path
✗ 32B row-group scheduling
✗ dtype/shape 特殊 Tile
```

只有：

```text
4096 固定 Tile
两遍逐行处理
FP32 中间计算
ReduceSum
每行重新读取 gamma/bias
DataCopyPad
普通 dtype dispatch
```

唯一为了 correctness 保留的调度规则是：

```text
rowBytes % 32 == 0
→ 普通多核逐行

rowBytes % 32 != 0
→ 单核
```

这样没有借用 `R012 row-group` 的优化思想，同时避免非对齐行跨核写同一 32B block 的风险。

```text
Parent = B0-PURE-V001
```


核心变化只有：

```cpp
rowGroup = 32 / gcd(rowBytes, 32);
```

然后：

```text
连续 row
    ↓
组成最小 32B 对齐 group
    ↓
group 作为多核调度单位
    ↓
```

```text
非32B对齐 row
B0 → 单核
```

变成：

```text
非32B对齐 row
PURE-R012 → 组成32B group后重新启用多核
```

        AscendC::Duplicate(sum, 0.0f, 1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();

        int32_t partialCount = 0;

        for (uint64_t col = 0; col < rowWidth; col += kTileElems) {
            const int32_t valid = TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            Load(xLocal, xGm_, rowOffset + col, valid);

## 你原本要求的应该是这样

`B0` 只负责提供：

> 数学语义、ABI、正确性参考。

它**不应该成为每条路线都复制粘贴后只修改几十行的代码模板**。

每条支线应该围绕自己的核心思想，把 Kernel 的数据流、UB 布局、Tile、调度、循环组织甚至 Host dispatch **整体重新设计**。

例如真正的 `R006 Reduction` 路线，不应该只是：

```text
B0
+ 把几个 partial 放一起 ReduceSum
```

而应该是：

```text
R006 Reduction-centric Kernel

GM
 ↓
大块/专用 Reduction Tile
 ↓
Vector 层局部平方
 ↓
分层 Partial Sum
 ↓
UB Reduction Tree
 ↓
尽量减少 V↔S 交互
 ↓
最终 RMS scalar
 ↓
输出 pass
```

它的整个 Kernel 都围绕 **“如何让 reduction 最快”** 来设计。

这时代码当然可能变成 700、1200、2000 行，而不是固定在 430 行左右。
