# -----------------------------
# FULL-R014-V001 parameter-residency architecture
# -----------------------------
code = r'''#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias - FULL-R014-V001-PARAMETER-RESIDENCY-ARCH
 *
 * Branch:
 *   R014 / parameter-residency-centric architecture.
 *
 * This is a branch-level rewrite.  The design is not a B0 patch and does not
 * descend from FULL-R006.  The only semantic contract inherited is the Golden:
 *
 *   y = x + residual
 *   rms = sqrt(mean(y * y) + epsilon)
 *   out = y / rms * gamma + bias
 *
 * Architecture objective:
 *   Make gamma/bias residency in UB the central design decision.
 *
 * Main path (D <= 8192):
 *   1. Each vector core receives a contiguous row interval.
 *   2. Before processing its rows, the core loads the complete gamma and bias
 *      vectors exactly once and promotes them to persistent FP32 UB storage.
 *   3. All rows assigned to the core reuse those resident FP32 parameters.
 *   4. The row work tile is 4096 elements, chosen so two resident D=8192 FP32
 *      parameter vectors coexist with input/output/reduction working storage.
 *   5. The output pass therefore has no gamma/bias GM traffic and no repeated
 *      low-precision parameter casts.
 *
 * Fallback path (D > 8192):
 *   Parameters are streamed per tile.  This fallback intentionally stays
 *   simple; the first-submit question for R014 is whether full per-core
 *   parameter residency is valuable where it fits naturally.
 *
 * Explicitly absent:
 *   - retained-y cache;
 *   - wide cached-row architecture;
 *   - multi-row vector batching;
 *   - double-buffer/ping-pong pipeline;
 *   - hierarchical partial collector from R006;
 *   - row-group scheduling from R012;
 *   - aligned DataCopy fast path from R009;
 *   - manual-tail split from R010;
 *   - reciprocal/Muls normalization from R019;
 *   - R031 multimode architecture.
 *
 * Correctness scheduling:
 *   Naturally 32-byte-aligned rows use ordinary multicore distribution.
 *   Non-aligned rows use one core so DataCopyPad stores cannot race on a
 *   partially shared 32-byte GM block.  This is deliberately conservative
 *   and is not the R012 optimization.
 *
 * File format:
 *   Delivered as .txt. Rename to kernel.asc for submission if required.
 */

template <typename T>
class ParameterResidencyKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kWorkTileElems = 4096;
    static constexpr int32_t kResidentMaxWidth = 8192;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarAlignedOffset = 8;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output,
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)output);

        residentMode_ =
            rowWidth <= static_cast<uint64_t>(kResidentMaxWidth);

        /*
         * Working-set layout.
         *
         * Worst-case resident mode for T=float:
         *   gammaResident_ : 8192 * 4 = 32 KiB
         *   biasResident_  : 8192 * 4 = 32 KiB
         *   xNative_       : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   rNative_       : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   outNative_     : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   valueFp32_     : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   auxFp32_       : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   reduceFp32_    : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   scalar_        : 64 B
         *
         * Total ~160 KiB, leaving headroom under the target UB budget.
         */
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            xNative_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(T));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            rNative_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(T));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            outNative_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(T));

        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            valueFp32_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(float));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            auxFp32_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(float));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            reduceFp32_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(float));

        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            scalar_,
            kScalarElems * sizeof(float));

        if (residentMode_) {
            pipe_.InitBuffer(
                gammaResident_,
                kResidentMaxWidth * sizeof(float));
            pipe_.InitBuffer(
                biasResident_,
                kResidentMaxWidth * sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Run(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        /*
         * Contiguous row ownership is intentional for this route: one core
         * prepares one resident parameter image and then consumes it over its
         * complete local row interval.
         */
        const uint64_t baseRows =
            rowCount / static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);
        const uint64_t extraRows =
            rowCount % static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            blockIdx * baseRows +
            (blockIdx < extraRows ? blockIdx : extraRows);

        const uint64_t localRows =
            baseRows +
            (blockIdx < extraRows ? 1ULL : 0ULL);

        const uint64_t endRow =
            beginRow + localRows;

        if (localRows == 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residentMode_) {
            PrepareResidentParameters(rowWidth);

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {
                ProcessResidentRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
            return;
        }

        for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
             row < endRow;
             ++row) {
            ProcessStreamingRow(
                row,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
        }
    }

private:
    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remaining) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remaining >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(kWorkTileElems)
                ? kWorkTileElems
                : remaining);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void LoadNative(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams params(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> pad;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            params,
            pad);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void StoreNative(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams params(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            params);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFp32(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);
        } else {
            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void FromFp32(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);
        } else {
            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMte2ToVector()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVectorToMte2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVectorToMte3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMte3ToVector()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVectorToScalar()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncScalarToVector()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    /*
     * Resident parameter image:
     *
     * gamma and bias are promoted once into FP32 UB.  The native staging
     * buffers are then free for row data for the rest of this core's work.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void PrepareResidentParameters(
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaStage =
            xNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasStage =
            rNative_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaResident =
            gammaResident_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasResident =
            biasResident_.Get<float>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadNative(
                gammaStage,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);
            LoadNative(
                biasStage,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMte2ToVector();

            ToFp32(
                gammaResident[col],
                gammaStage,
                valid);
            ToFp32(
                biasResident[col],
                biasStage,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            /*
             * Do not refill the native staging buffers until their conversion
             * has fully consumed them.
             */
            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }
    }

    /*
     * Form x + residual in FP32.
     *
     * valueFp32_ receives y.  auxFp32_ is temporary conversion storage.
     * This function is shared by reduction and output passes.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void LoadAndFormY(
        uint64_t gmOffset,
        int32_t valid)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> rLocal =
            rNative_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();

        LoadNative(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            gmOffset,
            valid);
        LoadNative(
            rLocal,
            residualGm_,
            gmOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMte2ToVector();

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Add(
                value,
                xLocal,
                rLocal,
                valid);
        } else {
            /*
             * value temporarily receives x; aux receives residual.  The final
             * Add is safe in-place on value.
             */
            ToFp32(
                value,
                xLocal,
                valid);
            ToFp32(
                aux,
                rLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                value,
                value,
                aux,
                valid);
        }

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }

    /*
     * Row RMS reduction.
     *
     * Two scalar slots are deliberately separated by eight FP32 elements
     * (32 bytes), matching the alignment pattern used by the validated
     * correctness/reference implementations.
     */
    __aicore__ inline float ComputeRms(
        uint64_t rowOffset,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> scalarSlots =
            scalar_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            scalarSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rowSum =
            scalarSlots[kScalarAlignedOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> reduceTmp =
            reduceFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rowSum,
            0.0f,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadAndFormY(
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            /*
             * aux becomes y^2; value remains available only until this point
             * and is intentionally not retained across passes in R014.
             */
            AscendC::Mul(
                aux,
                value,
                value,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                aux,
                reduceTmp,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rowSum,
                rowSum,
                partial,
                1);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rowSum,
            rowSum,
            invRowWidth,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rowSum,
            rowSum,
            epsilon,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rowSum,
            rowSum,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVectorToScalar();

        const float rmsValue =
            rowSum.GetValue(0);

        SyncScalarToVector();

        return rmsValue;
    }

    /*
     * Resident output path.
     *
     * No GM parameter load occurs here.  The output tile only reloads
     * x/residual, normalizes y, then consumes gamma/bias directly from the
     * persistent FP32 resident vectors.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void WriteResidentOutput(
        uint64_t rowOffset,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float rmsValue)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaResident =
            gammaResident_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasResident =
            biasResident_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> outLocal =
            outNative_.Get<T>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadAndFormY(
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                aux,
                rmsValue,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                value,
                value,
                aux,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                value,
                value,
                gammaResident[col],
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                value,
                value,
                biasResident[col],
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    value,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            } else {
                FromFp32(
                    outLocal,
                    value,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    outLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            }

            /*
             * LoadAndFormY on the next tile reuses the native x/residual
             * staging buffers.
             */
            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }
    }

    /*
     * Streaming output fallback for D > resident capacity.
     *
     * This path deliberately does not introduce another optimization family.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void WriteStreamingOutput(
        uint64_t rowOffset,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float rmsValue)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> rLocal =
            rNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> outLocal =
            outNative_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
            reduceFp32_.Get<float>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadAndFormY(
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                aux,
                rmsValue,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                value,
                value,
                aux,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            /*
             * y is complete; native x/residual buffers can now stage
             * gamma/bias for this channel tile.
             */
            SyncVectorToMte2();

            LoadNative(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);
            LoadNative(
                rLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMte2ToVector();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                AscendC::Mul(
                    value,
                    value,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                AscendC::Add(
                    value,
                    value,
                    rLocal,
                    valid);
            } else {
                ToFp32(
                    aux,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);
                ToFp32(
                    biasFp32,
                    rLocal,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                AscendC::Mul(
                    value,
                    value,
                    aux,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                AscendC::Add(
                    value,
                    value,
                    biasFp32,
                    valid);
            }

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    value,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            } else {
                FromFp32(
                    outLocal,
                    value,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    outLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            }

            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessResidentRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        const float rmsValue =
            ComputeRms(
                rowOffset,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

        WriteResidentOutput(
            rowOffset,
            rowWidth,
            rmsValue);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessStreamingRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        const float rmsValue =
            ComputeRms(
                rowOffset,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

        WriteStreamingOutput(
            rowOffset,
            rowWidth,
            rmsValue);
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe pipe_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xNative_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        rNative_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        outNative_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        valueFp32_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        auxFp32_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        reduceFp32_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        scalar_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        gammaResident_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        biasResident_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;

    bool residentMode_;
};

template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_r014(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    ParameterResidencyKernel<T> kernel;

    kernel.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output,
        rowWidth);

    kernel.Run(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}

#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)
extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,
    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||
        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {
        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||
        residualInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        outputInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        xInfo.dtype != residualInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != gammaInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != biasInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != outputInfo.dtype) {
        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {
        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned ||
        residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned ||
        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {
        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0 ||
            residualInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned) {
            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(extentSigned);

        if (rowCount > maxU64 / extent) {
            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (rowCount == 0) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(widthSigned);

    if (rowCount > maxU64 / rowWidth) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0 ? 4ULL : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth > maxU64 / elementBytes) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth * elementBytes;

    const bool naturallyAligned =
        (rowBytes & 31ULL) == 0ULL;

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        naturallyAligned &&
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks > rowCount) {
        requestedBlocks = rowCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0) {
        requestedBlocks = 1;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks >
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU)) {
        requestedBlocks =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                0xffffffffU);
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {
        add_rms_norm_bias_r014<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {
        add_rms_norm_bias_r014<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    } else {
        add_rms_norm_bias_r014<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}
#endif

    if ch == "{":
        brace += 1

sha = hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
static = {

        "contiguous row ownership to maximize per-core reuse",

        "R006 hierarchical reduction",

    ],
    "sha256":sha,

    "device_kernel_present":"__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_r014" in code,

}
Path("/mnt/data/FULL-R014-V001_STATIC.json").write_text(

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include "kernel_operator.h"

/*
 * AddRmsNormBias - FULL-R014-V001-PARAMETER-RESIDENCY-ARCH
 *
 * Branch:
 *   R014 / parameter-residency-centric architecture.
 *
 * This is a branch-level rewrite.  The design is not a B0 patch and does not
 * descend from FULL-R006.  The only semantic contract inherited is the Golden:
 *
 *   y = x + residual
 *   rms = sqrt(mean(y * y) + epsilon)
 *   out = y / rms * gamma + bias
 *
 * Architecture objective:
 *   Make gamma/bias residency in UB the central design decision.
 *
 * Main path (D <= 8192):
 *   1. Each vector core receives a contiguous row interval.
 *   2. Before processing its rows, the core loads the complete gamma and bias
 *      vectors exactly once and promotes them to persistent FP32 UB storage.
 *   3. All rows assigned to the core reuse those resident FP32 parameters.
 *   4. The row work tile is 4096 elements, chosen so two resident D=8192 FP32
 *      parameter vectors coexist with input/output/reduction working storage.
 *   5. The output pass therefore has no gamma/bias GM traffic and no repeated
 *      low-precision parameter casts.
 *
 * Fallback path (D > 8192):
 *   Parameters are streamed per tile.  This fallback intentionally stays
 *   simple; the first-submit question for R014 is whether full per-core
 *   parameter residency is valuable where it fits naturally.
 *
 * Explicitly absent:
 *   - retained-y cache;
 *   - wide cached-row architecture;
 *   - multi-row vector batching;
 *   - double-buffer/ping-pong pipeline;
 *   - hierarchical partial collector from R006;
 *   - row-group scheduling from R012;
 *   - aligned DataCopy fast path from R009;
 *   - manual-tail split from R010;
 *   - reciprocal/Muls normalization from R019;
 *   - R031 multimode architecture.
 *
 * Correctness scheduling:
 *   Naturally 32-byte-aligned rows use ordinary multicore distribution.
 *   Non-aligned rows use one core so DataCopyPad stores cannot race on a
 *   partially shared 32-byte GM block.  This is deliberately conservative
 *   and is not the R012 optimization.
 *
 * File format:
 *   Delivered as .txt. Rename to kernel.asc for submission if required.
 */

template <typename T>
class ParameterResidencyKernel {
public:
    static constexpr int32_t kWorkTileElems = 4096;
    static constexpr int32_t kResidentMaxWidth = 8192;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarElems = 16;
    static constexpr int32_t kScalarAlignedOffset = 8;

    __aicore__ inline void Init(
        GM_ADDR x,
        GM_ADDR residual,
        GM_ADDR gamma,
        GM_ADDR bias,
        GM_ADDR output,
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)x);
        residualGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)residual);
        gammaGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)gamma);
        biasGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)bias);
        outputGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T*)output);

        residentMode_ =
            rowWidth <= static_cast<uint64_t>(kResidentMaxWidth);

        /*
         * Working-set layout.
         *
         * Worst-case resident mode for T=float:
         *   gammaResident_ : 8192 * 4 = 32 KiB
         *   biasResident_  : 8192 * 4 = 32 KiB
         *   xNative_       : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   rNative_       : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   outNative_     : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   valueFp32_     : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   auxFp32_       : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   reduceFp32_    : 4096 * 4 = 16 KiB
         *   scalar_        : 64 B
         *
         * Total ~160 KiB, leaving headroom under the target UB budget.
         */
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            xNative_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(T));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            rNative_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(T));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            outNative_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(T));

        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            valueFp32_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(float));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            auxFp32_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(float));
        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            reduceFp32_,
            kWorkTileElems * sizeof(float));

        pipe_.InitBuffer(
            scalar_,
            kScalarElems * sizeof(float));

        if (residentMode_) {
            pipe_.InitBuffer(
                gammaResident_,
                kResidentMaxWidth * sizeof(float));
            pipe_.InitBuffer(
                biasResident_,
                kResidentMaxWidth * sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Run(
        uint64_t rowCount,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        uint32_t blockCount,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t blockIdx =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(AscendC::GetBlockIdx());

        /*
         * Contiguous row ownership is intentional for this route: one core
         * prepares one resident parameter image and then consumes it over its
         * complete local row interval.
         */
        const uint64_t baseRows =
            rowCount / static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);
        const uint64_t extraRows =
            rowCount % static_cast<uint64_t>(blockCount);

        const uint64_t beginRow =
            blockIdx * baseRows +
            (blockIdx < extraRows ? blockIdx : extraRows);

        const uint64_t localRows =
            baseRows +
            (blockIdx < extraRows ? 1ULL : 0ULL);

        const uint64_t endRow =
            beginRow + localRows;

        if (localRows == 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (residentMode_) {
            PrepareResidentParameters(rowWidth);

            for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
                 row < endRow;
                 ++row) {
                ProcessResidentRow(
                    row,
                    rowWidth,
                    invRowWidth,
                    epsilon);
            }
            return;
        }

        for (uint64_t row = beginRow;
             row < endRow;
             ++row) {
            ProcessStreamingRow(
                row,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
        }
    }

private:
    __aicore__ inline int32_t TileLength(
        uint64_t remaining) const
    {
        return static_cast<int32_t>(
            remaining >
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(kWorkTileElems)
                ? kWorkTileElems
                : remaining);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void LoadNative(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& src,
        uint64_t offset,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams params(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        const AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> pad;

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst,
            src[offset],
            params,
            pad);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void StoreNative(
        const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& dst,
        uint64_t offset,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        const AscendC::DataCopyExtParams params(
            1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(
                count *
                static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof(T))),
            0,
            0,
            0);

        AscendC::DataCopyPad(
            dst[offset],
            src,
            params);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ToFp32(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);
        } else {
            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void FromFp32(
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<T>& dst,
        const AscendC::LocalTensor<float>& src,
        int32_t count)
    {
        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Adds(
                dst,
                src,
                0.0f,
                count);
        } else {
            AscendC::Cast(
                dst,
                src,
                AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_RINT,
                count);
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMte2ToVector()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVectorToMte2()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE2>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVectorToMte3()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_MTE3>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncMte3ToVector()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::MTE3_V>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncVectorToScalar()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::V_S>(0);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void SyncScalarToVector()
    {
        AscendC::SetFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
        AscendC::WaitFlag<
            AscendC::HardEvent::S_V>(0);
    }

    /*
     * Resident parameter image:
     *
     * gamma and bias are promoted once into FP32 UB.  The native staging
     * buffers are then free for row data for the rest of this core's work.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void PrepareResidentParameters(
        uint64_t rowWidth)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> gammaStage =
            xNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> biasStage =
            rNative_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaResident =
            gammaResident_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasResident =
            biasResident_.Get<float>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadNative(
                gammaStage,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);
            LoadNative(
                biasStage,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMte2ToVector();

            ToFp32(
                gammaResident[col],
                gammaStage,
                valid);
            ToFp32(
                biasResident[col],
                biasStage,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            /*
             * Do not refill the native staging buffers until their conversion
             * has fully consumed them.
             */
            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }
    }

    /*
     * Form x + residual in FP32.
     *
     * valueFp32_ receives y.  auxFp32_ is temporary conversion storage.
     * This function is shared by reduction and output passes.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void LoadAndFormY(
        uint64_t gmOffset,
        int32_t valid)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> rLocal =
            rNative_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();

        LoadNative(
            xLocal,
            xGm_,
            gmOffset,
            valid);
        LoadNative(
            rLocal,
            residualGm_,
            gmOffset,
            valid);

        SyncMte2ToVector();

        if constexpr (
            AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
            AscendC::Add(
                value,
                xLocal,
                rLocal,
                valid);
        } else {
            /*
             * value temporarily receives x; aux receives residual.  The final
             * Add is safe in-place on value.
             */
            ToFp32(
                value,
                xLocal,
                valid);
            ToFp32(
                aux,
                rLocal,
                valid);

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                value,
                value,
                aux,
                valid);
        }

        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }

    /*
     * Row RMS reduction.
     *
     * Two scalar slots are deliberately separated by eight FP32 elements
     * (32 bytes), matching the alignment pattern used by the validated
     * correctness/reference implementations.
     */
    __aicore__ inline float ComputeRms(
        uint64_t rowOffset,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> scalarSlots =
            scalar_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> partial =
            scalarSlots;

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> rowSum =
            scalarSlots[kScalarAlignedOffset];

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> reduceTmp =
            reduceFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::Duplicate(
            rowSum,
            0.0f,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadAndFormY(
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            /*
             * aux becomes y^2; value remains available only until this point
             * and is intentionally not retained across passes in R014.
             */
            AscendC::Mul(
                aux,
                value,
                value,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::ReduceSum(
                partial,
                aux,
                reduceTmp,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                rowSum,
                rowSum,
                partial,
                1);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }

        AscendC::Muls(
            rowSum,
            rowSum,
            invRowWidth,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Adds(
            rowSum,
            rowSum,
            epsilon,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        AscendC::Sqrt(
            rowSum,
            rowSum,
            1);
        AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        SyncVectorToScalar();

        const float rmsValue =
            rowSum.GetValue(0);

        SyncScalarToVector();

        return rmsValue;
    }

    /*
     * Resident output path.
     *
     * No GM parameter load occurs here.  The output tile only reloads
     * x/residual, normalizes y, then consumes gamma/bias directly from the
     * persistent FP32 resident vectors.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void WriteResidentOutput(
        uint64_t rowOffset,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float rmsValue)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> gammaResident =
            gammaResident_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasResident =
            biasResident_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> outLocal =
            outNative_.Get<T>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadAndFormY(
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                aux,
                rmsValue,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                value,
                value,
                aux,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Mul(
                value,
                value,
                gammaResident[col],
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Add(
                value,
                value,
                biasResident[col],
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    value,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            } else {
                FromFp32(
                    outLocal,
                    value,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    outLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            }

            /*
             * LoadAndFormY on the next tile reuses the native x/residual
             * staging buffers.
             */
            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }
    }

    /*
     * Streaming output fallback for D > resident capacity.
     *
     * This path deliberately does not introduce another optimization family.
     */
    __aicore__ inline void WriteStreamingOutput(
        uint64_t rowOffset,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float rmsValue)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal =
            xNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> rLocal =
            rNative_.Get<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> outLocal =
            outNative_.Get<T>();

        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> value =
            valueFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> aux =
            auxFp32_.Get<float>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<float> biasFp32 =
            reduceFp32_.Get<float>();

        for (uint64_t col = 0;
             col < rowWidth;
             col += static_cast<uint64_t>(
                 kWorkTileElems)) {
            const int32_t valid =
                TileLength(rowWidth - col);

            LoadAndFormY(
                rowOffset + col,
                valid);

            AscendC::Duplicate(
                aux,
                rmsValue,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            AscendC::Div(
                value,
                value,
                aux,
                valid);
            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            /*
             * y is complete; native x/residual buffers can now stage
             * gamma/bias for this channel tile.
             */
            SyncVectorToMte2();

            LoadNative(
                xLocal,
                gammaGm_,
                col,
                valid);
            LoadNative(
                rLocal,
                biasGm_,
                col,
                valid);

            SyncMte2ToVector();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                AscendC::Mul(
                    value,
                    value,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                AscendC::Add(
                    value,
                    value,
                    rLocal,
                    valid);
            } else {
                ToFp32(
                    aux,
                    xLocal,
                    valid);
                ToFp32(
                    biasFp32,
                    rLocal,
                    valid);

                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                AscendC::Mul(
                    value,
                    value,
                    aux,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                AscendC::Add(
                    value,
                    value,
                    biasFp32,
                    valid);
            }

            AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

            if constexpr (
                AscendC::IsSameType<T, float>::value) {
                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    value,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            } else {
                FromFp32(
                    outLocal,
                    value,
                    valid);
                AscendC::PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

                SyncVectorToMte3();

                StoreNative(
                    outputGm_,
                    rowOffset + col,
                    outLocal,
                    valid);

                SyncMte3ToVector();
            }

            SyncVectorToMte2();
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessResidentRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        const float rmsValue =
            ComputeRms(
                rowOffset,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

        WriteResidentOutput(
            rowOffset,
            rowWidth,
            rmsValue);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void ProcessStreamingRow(
        uint64_t row,
        uint64_t rowWidth,
        float invRowWidth,
        float epsilon)
    {
        const uint64_t rowOffset =
            row * rowWidth;

        const float rmsValue =
            ComputeRms(
                rowOffset,
                rowWidth,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);

        WriteStreamingOutput(
            rowOffset,
            rowWidth,
            rmsValue);
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe pipe_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        xNative_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        rNative_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        outNative_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        valueFp32_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        auxFp32_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        reduceFp32_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        scalar_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        gammaResident_;

    AscendC::TBuf<
        AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC>
        biasResident_;

    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> residualGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> gammaGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> biasGm_;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> outputGm_;

    bool residentMode_;
};

template <typename T>
__global__ __vector__ void add_rms_norm_bias_r014(
    GM_ADDR x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    uint64_t rowCount,
    uint64_t rowWidth,
    uint32_t blockCount,
    float invRowWidth,
    float epsilon)
{
    ParameterResidencyKernel<T> kernel;

    kernel.Init(
        x,
        residual,
        gamma,
        bias,
        output,
        rowWidth);

    kernel.Run(
        rowCount,
        rowWidth,
        blockCount,
        invRowWidth,
        epsilon);
}

#if !defined(ASCENDC_CPU_DEBUG)
extern "C" void run_kernel(
    GM_ADDR x,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_x,
    GM_ADDR residual,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_residual,
    GM_ADDR gamma,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_gamma,
    GM_ADDR bias,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_bias,
    GM_ADDR output,
    const TensorGroupInfo& info_output,
    int64_t availableCoreNum,
    aclrtStream stream,
    float epsilon)
{
    if (x == nullptr ||
        residual == nullptr ||
        gamma == nullptr ||
        bias == nullptr ||
        output == nullptr ||
        info_x.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_residual.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_gamma.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_bias.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_output.tensors == nullptr ||
        info_x.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_residual.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_gamma.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_bias.numTensors < 1 ||
        info_output.numTensors < 1) {
        return;
    }

    const TensorInfo& xInfo =
        info_x.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& residualInfo =
        info_residual.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& gammaInfo =
        info_gamma.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& biasInfo =
        info_bias.tensors[0];
    const TensorInfo& outputInfo =
        info_output.tensors[0];

    if (xInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        residualInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        gammaInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        biasInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        outputInfo.shape == nullptr ||
        xInfo.numDims < 1 ||
        residualInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        outputInfo.numDims != xInfo.numDims ||
        gammaInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        biasInfo.numDims != 1 ||
        xInfo.dtype != residualInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != gammaInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != biasInfo.dtype ||
        xInfo.dtype != outputInfo.dtype) {
        return;
    }

    if (xInfo.dtype != 0 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 1 &&
        xInfo.dtype != 2) {
        return;
    }

    const int64_t widthSigned =
        xInfo.shape[xInfo.numDims - 1];

    if (widthSigned <= 0 ||
        gammaInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned ||
        biasInfo.shape[0] != widthSigned ||
        residualInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned ||
        outputInfo.shape[
            xInfo.numDims - 1] != widthSigned) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t maxU64 =
        ~static_cast<uint64_t>(0);

    uint64_t rowCount = 1;

    for (int64_t dim = 0;
         dim < xInfo.numDims - 1;
         ++dim) {
        const int64_t extentSigned =
            xInfo.shape[dim];

        if (extentSigned <= 0 ||
            residualInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned ||
            outputInfo.shape[dim] != extentSigned) {
            return;
        }

        const uint64_t extent =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(extentSigned);

        if (rowCount > maxU64 / extent) {
            return;
        }

        rowCount *= extent;
    }

    if (rowCount == 0) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowWidth =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(widthSigned);

    if (rowCount > maxU64 / rowWidth) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t elementBytes =
        xInfo.dtype == 0 ? 4ULL : 2ULL;

    if (rowWidth > maxU64 / elementBytes) {
        return;
    }

    const uint64_t rowBytes =
        rowWidth * elementBytes;

    const bool naturallyAligned =
        (rowBytes & 31ULL) == 0ULL;

    uint64_t requestedBlocks =
        naturallyAligned &&
        availableCoreNum > 0
            ? static_cast<uint64_t>(
                  availableCoreNum)
            : 1ULL;

    if (requestedBlocks > rowCount) {
        requestedBlocks = rowCount;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks == 0) {
        requestedBlocks = 1;
    }

    if (requestedBlocks >
        static_cast<uint64_t>(
            0xffffffffU)) {
        requestedBlocks =
            static_cast<uint64_t>(
                0xffffffffU);
    }

    const uint32_t blockCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(
            requestedBlocks);

    const float invRowWidth =
        1.0f /
        static_cast<float>(
            widthSigned);

    if (xInfo.dtype == 0) {
        add_rms_norm_bias_r014<float>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    } else if (xInfo.dtype == 1) {
        add_rms_norm_bias_r014<half>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    } else {
        add_rms_norm_bias_r014<bfloat16_t>
            <<<blockCount, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x,
                residual,
                gamma,
                bias,
                output,
                rowCount,
                rowWidth,
                blockCount,
                invRowWidth,
                epsilon);
    }
}
#endif
```

```text
FULL-R014-V001  Parameter Residency Architecture
    → NEXT
```
